title: Calibrate Before Reason: Robust Visual Token Reduction against Semantic Drift in VLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from prohibitive inference overhead due to long sequences of visual tokens. However, existing visual token reduction methods mainly improve efficiency by pruning or compressing redundant tokens without examining whether the resulting representation remains semantically consistent with the original representation. Mapping the original N-token visual sequence to K tokens may discard, dilute, or misassign critical visual cues, triggering severe semantic drift that deviates the VLM's understanding. In this paper, we first introduce the principle of 'Calibrate Before Reason' to visual token reduction and propose CaRe, a training-free robust framework that calibrates compact visual representations before reasoning to preserve semantic fidelity in VLMs. CaRe consists of two mutually complementary modules: 1) Perturbation-Robust Calibration Anchoring, which identifies calibration anchors with stable model-side influence under multi-directional perturbations; 2) Confidence-Gated Token Calibration, which extracts reliable calibration signals from unselected tokens and injects them into anchors. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM architectures and benchmarks verify that CaRe outperforms state-of-the-art token reduction baselines. While pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, our method retains 96.4% of the original full-token performance, delivering up to 2.30 times faster end-to-end inference speed relative to unpruned vanilla models.

title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.

title: LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference
comments: 13 pages, journal version. Published in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems (JETCAS), vol. 15, no. 2, pp. 231-243, 2025, DOI: 10.1109/JETCAS.2025.3558300
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit to address key challenges in low-bit quantization, including the energy overhead of rotation operations. The proposed accelerator, implemented in a 28nm CMOS process, achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference, surpassing prior state-of-the-art designs. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on higher-precision inference or evaluate on basic language modeling tasks like GPT-2, LightRot is optimized for advanced models such as LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B. Its performance is further validated on MT-Bench, demonstrating robust applicability to real-world conversational scenarios and redefining benchmarks for chat-based AI systems. By synergizing algorithmic innovations and hardware efficiency, this work sets a new paradigm for scalable, low-bit LLM inference, paving the way for sustainable AI advancements.

title: Albilich: Steerable Proof-State Orchestration for LLM-Based Mathematical Research with CAS Integration
summary:
Large language models can contribute useful ideas to mathematical research, yet long-horizon proof attempts remain difficult to coordinate, evaluate, and reproduce. We present Albilich, an open-source agentic harness for autoresearch in mathematics that combines long-horizon reasoning, computer algebra systems (CAS), literature retrieval, and persistent SQLite-based context management.
  We evaluate Albilich on the RealMath benchmark (Zhang et al. 2025) and on open problems in group theory from the Kourovka Notebook (Khukhro and Mazurov 2026). It solved 10/10 problems on RealMath with CAS and 9/10 with no CAS. On the Kourovka problems, Albilich produced a counterexample to Problem 21.142 and a proof of a strengthening of Problem20.2. Anablation on Problem 17.91 demonstrates 32.0% token reduction when CAS is enabled. An ablation on Problem 21.142 demonstrates higher verifier-rejection rate and failure to synthesize proof routes in the absence of the advisor agent. These results support Albilich as a human-steerable, CAS-boosted environment for scalable AI-assisted mathematical research.

title: Structural Averaged Controllability for Linear Ensemble Systems: Multi-input Case
summary: We study structural averaged controllability for multi-input linear ensemble systems. In this problem, one asks whether a sparsity pattern admits a linear ensemble system that is averaged controllable. The single-input case has been characterized completely, while the general multi-input case has remained open. In this work, we give a complete characterization for the general multi-input case. In particular, we prove that in addition to accessibility, a necessary and sufficient condition for structural averaged controllability of ensemble systems is existence of a row-saturating matching for its \emph{core}, an acyclic subgraph associated with the system which plays a central role in the result for the single-input case.

title: MECA: A Mechanism-Centered Agent for Constructing Well-Specified and Valuable Mathematical Conjectures
comments: 78 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and the full collection of 100 generated conjectures
summary: Automatically constructing well-specified and valuable mathematical conjectures remains a central challenge in AI-assisted mathematical discovery. Many existing open problems and conjectures are often too broad, underspecified, or difficult to connect to plausible proof or refutation strategies. We view a mathematical mechanism as a structure or reasoning principle that connects the assumptions of a candidate problem to its target conclusion, such as an inequality, invariant, decomposition, or reduction to an intermediate claim. We present MECA (MEchanism-centered Conjecture Agent), a multi-agent framework that constructs conjectures by jointly developing candidate statements and their supporting mechanisms. Explorer agents propose mechanisms, test how they apply, and revise the candidate conjecture accordingly, while critic agents assess their mathematical validity and research value. Their feedback guides changes to the assumptions, scope, and conclusion. Through this process, MECA transforms broad research directions into precise conjectures with substantive mathematical support while retaining a clearly identified unresolved core. We evaluate MECA in two complementary settings. First, we compare it with a generate-and-revise baseline on reconstructing preselected target-paper conclusions from target-conditioned but article-blind source materials. Second, we construct 100 semi-open problems from literature-derived seeds and existing open problems and evaluate them through independent proof and refutation attempts by automated provers. Our results indicate that mechanism-centered refinement produces well-specified and research-worthy conjectures that remain challenging for current automated provers.

title: NMINE: Normalized Mutual Information Neural Estimation
summary:
Mutual information is a general measure of statistical dependence that captures both linear and nonlinear relationships between random variables. For continuous and multidimensional variables For continuous multidimensional variables, mutual information must be estimated from samples. Because mutual information is unbounded, its values are not directly comparable across datasets, dimensions, or applications. Normalized mutual information addresses this limitation by converting mutual information into a normalized dependency score. Recent work has demonstrated the practical value of normalized mutual information in applications such as molecular dynamics {arXiv:2405.04980} and interpretable machine learning {arXiv:2409.16768}, but existing estimators remain sensitive to dimensionality and numerical stability {arXiv:2410.07642}.
  In this paper, we propose a fully neural normalized mutual information estimator for continuous variables. The proposed approach combines a MINE-based neural mutual information estimator {arXiv:1801.04062} with MI-NEE-inspired neural marginal entropy estimators {arXiv:1905.12957}. Mutual information is estimated using the Donsker--Varadhan representation, while marginal entropies are estimated by learning the divergence between each marginal distribution and a uniform reference distribution, from which entropy is recovered. The resulting estimator provides a neural alternative to k-nearest-neighbor-based normalized mutual information estimation {arXiv:2405.04980}.
  Experiments on Gaussian data from one to eight dimensions show that the proposed estimator improves accuracy over a KSG-based normalized mutual information baseline. These results indicate that neural estimation is a promising direction for normalized dependency measurement in continuous multidimensional settings.

AI.title_translation: NMINE：归一化互信息神经网络估计

AI.motivation: 互信息无上界，导致其数值无法在不同数据集、维度或应用之间直接比较。现有的归一化互信息估计器（如基于kNN/KSG的方法）对维度和数值稳定性较为敏感。

AI.summary: 本文针对连续多维随机变量，提出了全神经网络归一化互信息估计器（NMINE）。由于传统NMI估计器易受维度与数值不稳定性影响，NMINE结合了基于Donsker-Varadhan表示的互信息估计和学习边缘分布与均匀分布散度的边缘熵估计，为基于kNN的估计方法提供了高效的神经网络替代方案，显著提升了高斯数据上的依赖性度量精度。

title: VESTIGE: A Knowledge-Guided Masking Strategy for Corruption-Aware Fine-Tuning of Genomic Transformers, Validated on Ancient DNA Reconstruction
summary: Standard masked-language-model fine-tuning applies a uniform masking probability across every token position, assuming reconstruction difficulty is position-agnostic. When the degradation process is characterised and concentrated at predictable positions, this assumption fails: at peak damage sites the model can underperform a frequency-matched random predictor. We introduce VESTIGE, a parameter-free, drop-in replacement for the standard MLM collator that aligns the masking distribution with an empirically measured per-position corruption profile. We apply it to ancient DNA (aDNA) reconstruction, where cytosine deamination produces a position-dependent C-to-T / G-to-A gradient quantified per-position by mapDamage2. Rescaling so the mean C/G masking rate equals 15% - identical to standard MLM - isolates spatial redistribution as the sole variable, with model, data, seed, and hyperparameters held fixed across both DNABERT-2 runs on a mammoth CDS corpus (two specimens, seven genes). Across six terminal-zone widths and 626 paired windows, VESTIGE leads standard MLM at every width (Delta = +4.18 to +10.35 pp, all p < 10^-8), cuts validation cross-entropy by 13% (3.274 vs. 3.757), and yields ESMFold reconstructions with TM-score > 0.95 across all six reconstructions (three genes) even under damage amplified 10-30x beyond authentic PMD rates. A 1D CNN biosecurity classifier returns AUC = 0.935 and clears 98.2% of reconstructed windows, the 1.76% remainder attributable to reference-genome features, not reconstruction artefacts. The principle is domain-agnostic: any measurable position- or context-specific corruption profile - FFPE, bisulfite, metagenomic, or nanopore - substitutes directly for the PMD array, making VESTIGE a knowledge-guided training routine for intelligent systems operating on degraded or noisy sequence inputs.

AI.title_translation: VESTIGE：用于基因组Transformer损伤感知微调的知识引导掩码策略，在古DNA重建上的验证
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为VESTIGE的知识引导掩码策略，通过对齐位置特异性降解特征，大幅提升了基因组Transformer处理古DNA等降解序列的重建能力。
AI.motivation: 标准的掩码语言模型微调假设重建难度与位置无关，采用统一的掩码概率。然而，当降解过程集中在可预测的位置时（例如古DNA的损伤位点），这种假设会失效，导致模型在关键损伤位点的性能甚至不如频率匹配的随机预测器。
AI.method: 提出VESTIGE策略，作为标准MLM胶合板（collator）的无参数替代方案，将掩码分布与经验测量的每个位置的腐败特征（如古DNA中的胞嘧啶脱氨基梯度）进行对齐，并在保持平均掩码率不变的情况下重新调整空间分布。
AI.result: 在猛犸象CDS语料库的实验中，VESTIGE在所有测试宽度上均显著优于标准MLM（提升4.18至10.35个百分点），将验证交叉熵降低了13%，在放大30倍损伤的情况下仍能保持高质量的结构重建（TM评分>0.95），并且生物安全性分类器表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VESTIGE通过将领域知识（如位置相关损伤分布）融入掩码策略，显著提升了基因组Transformer在处理降解序列（如古DNA）时的重建精度和鲁棒性，且该方法具有广泛的领域普适性。
AI.translation: 标准的掩码语言模型微调在每个标记位置应用统一的掩码概率，假设重建难度与位置无关。当降解过程具有特征性并集中在可预测的位置时，这一假设便会失效：在峰值损伤位点，模型的表现甚至不如频率匹配的随机预测器。我们引入了VESTIGE，它是标准MLM数据整理器的一个无参数、即插即用的替代品，能够将掩码分布与经验测量的每个位置的腐败轮廓进行对齐。我们将其应用于古DNA（aDNA）重建，其中胞嘧啶脱氨基作用会产生一个位置相关的C-to-T / G-to-A梯度，该梯度由mapDamage2按位置进行量化。通过重新缩放使平均C/G掩码率等于15%（与标准MLM相同），从而将空间重新分布作为唯一的变量，同时在猛犸象CDS语料库（两个标本，七个基因）的两次DNABERT-2运行中保持模型、数据、随机种子和超参数固定。在六个末端区域宽度和626个成对窗口中，VESTIGE在所有宽度上均领先于标准MLM（Delta = +4.18 至 +10.35 pp，所有 p < 10^-8），将验证交叉熵降低了13%（3.274 对比 3.757），并且即使在损伤被放大到超出真实PMD速率10-30倍的情况下，使用ESMFold重建的三个基因在所有六个重建中也均获得了 TM-score > 0.95 的结果。一个1D CNN生物安全分类器返回了 AUC = 0.935 并清理了 98.2% 的重建窗口，剩余的 1.76% 归因于参考基因组特征，而非重建伪影。该原理具有领域不可知性：任何可测量的位置或背景特异性腐败轮廓——如 FFPE、亚硫酸氢盐、宏基因组或纳米孔测序——都可以直接替代 PMD 阵列，这使得 VESTIGE 成为一种用于对降解或噪声序列输入进行操作的智能系统的知识引导训练例程。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了VESTIGE，一种用于基因组Transformer微调的知识引导掩码策略。针对标准MLM无法适应位置特异性降解的缺陷，VESTIGE通过对齐经验测量的腐败轮廓来调整掩码分布。在古DNA重建任务上的验证表明，该方法显著提升了重建精度、降低了交叉熵，并展现出处理高度降解序列的强大鲁棒性，且该原理可推广至其他类型的测序噪声和降解。

title: Write-Safe Flow Field Mapping under Ambiguous Onboard Sensing and Localization Drift
summary: Mobile robots can infer local flow structure from onboard sensing, but a locally plausible estimate is not always safe to write into a global map. Similar flow structures may produce ambiguous observations, while localization drift causes predicted patches to be written at incorrect locations. Repeated misregistered updates then accumulate into persistent ghost structures. We address this failure mode with a map-reference-aware conservative fusion framework. The model predicts a local velocity patch and a learned write-safety score that continuously attenuates uncertain map updates while permitting initialization when no reliable map reference is available. Across synthetic jet and crossflow environments, the proposed method reduces average ghost contamination by 42% relative to ungated fusion. A zero-shot hardware replay using real pressure and optical-flow measurements from a thruster wake further reduces ghost contamination by 39% while retaining 81% map coverage. These results show that safe map writing is critical for flow mapping under ambiguous sensing and localization drift.

AI.title_translation: 在模糊机载传感与定位漂移下的写入安全流场映射
AI.tldr: 提出了一种保守的融合框架，通过学习写入安全评分，解决移动机器人在流场建图中的感知模糊与定位漂移导致的幽灵结构问题。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人在通过机载传感推断局部流场结构时，局部合理的估计并不一定安全写入全局地图；相似的流场结构会导致模糊的观测，且定位漂移会导致预测补丁写入错误位置，重复的错误配准更新会累积成持久的幽灵结构。
AI.method: 提出了一种地图参考自感知保守融合框架（map-reference-aware conservative fusion framework），通过预测局部速度补丁和一个学习得到的写入安全评分，在持续减弱不确定地图更新的同时，允许在无可靠地图参考时进行初始化。
AI.result: 在合成射流和横流环境中，该方法较未门控融合将平均幽灵污染降低了42%；使用推进器尾流的真实压力和光流测量进行的零样本硬件回放进一步将幽灵污染降低了39%，同时保留了81%的地图覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的地图参考自感知保守融合框架能够有效解决移动机器人在流场建图中的定位漂移与感知模糊问题，显著降低幽灵结构污染，保障建图的准确性与安全性。
AI.translation: 移动机器人可以通过机载传感推断局部流场结构，但局部合理的估计并不总能安全地写入全局地图。相似的流场结构可能会产生模糊的观测，而定位漂移会导致预测的补丁被写入错误的位置。重复的错误配准更新随后会累积成持久的幽灵结构。我们通过一个地图参考感知保守融合框架来解决这种失效模式。该模型预测局部速度补丁和一个学习得到的写入安全评分，该评分持续衰减不确定的地图更新，同时在没有可靠地图参考时允许初始化。在合成射流和横流环境中，所提出的方法将平均幽灵污染比未门控融合降低了42%。使用来自推进器尾流的真实压力和光流测量的零样本硬件回放进一步将幽灵污染降低了39%，同时保留了81%的地图覆盖率。这些结果表明，安全的地图写入对于在模糊传感和定位漂移下的流场建图至关重要。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种用于移动机器人在模糊机载传感和定位漂移下的安全流场建图框架，通过引入学习型的写入安全评分来衰减不确定更新，显著减少了全局地图中的幽灵结构污染。
AI.keywords: 流场建图, 移动机器人, 写入安全, 定位漂移, 传感器模糊
AI.comments: 该论文针对移动机器人在未知或含噪声环境下的流场全局地图构建问题，创新性地引入了基于学习的写入安全评分机制，有效解决了由于感知模糊和定位漂移导致的“幽灵结构”污染问题，在理论验证和实际硬件回放中均表现出色。

title: New Synchronous Computation Dynamics for Hopfield Networks
summary: The dynamics of the original Hopfield network is asynchronous (sequential) (updates the state of only one neuron per time step). In this paper, we propose a new tool and a new dynamics to reduce the processing time by updating one or more neurons simultaneously per instant while ensuring process convergence and aiming for the maximum energy decrease at each step, thus guaranteeing the shortest total processing time. From the point of view of synchronous dynamics, calculating the next network state at which energy decreases the most from the current state while ensuring convergence is itself a combinatorial optimization problem. We develop and use a new tool to solve it. We call this new tool Discrete Differential Filter (DDF) and, based upon it, we develop a new synchronous dynamics which we call SD-DDF (Synchronous Dynamics based upon Discrete Differential Filter). In this paper, we review the original asynchronous dynamics for Hopfield networks and present a new tool and a new synchronous dynamics with its theoretical justification and four computational experiments to assess the speed up in processing time empirically.

AI.title_translation: Hopfield网络的新同步计算动力学
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散微分滤波器（DDF）的Hopfield网络新同步动力学（SD-DDF），通过同时更新多个神经元来加速处理过程并保证能量收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统的Hopfield网络采用异步（顺序）更新动力学，每个时间步仅更新一个神经元，导致处理时间较长。本文旨在提出一种新的同步动力学方法，通过同时更新一个或多个神经元来减少处理时间，同时确保过程收敛并追求每一步最大的能量下降。
AI.method: 开发了一种名为“离散微分滤波器（DDF）”的新工具，用以求解在保证收敛的前提下使网络能量最大化下降的同步状态更新组合优化问题，并据此构建了SD-DDF同步动力学。
AI.result: 通过四个计算实验对处理时间的加速进行了经验评估，理论和实验结果均证实了新方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于离散微分滤波器的同步动力学（SD-DDF）能够在保证系统收敛的前提下，实现神经元的并行/同步更新，从而显著减少Hopfield网络的处理时间。
AI.translation: 原始Hopfield网络的动力学是异步（顺序）的（每个时间步只更新一个神经元的StateType）。在本文中，我们提出了一种新工具和新动力学，通过在每个瞬间同时更新一个或多个神经元来减少处理时间，同时确保过程收敛并旨在实现每一步的最大能量下降，从而保证最短的总处理时间。从同步动力学的角度来看，计算能量从当前状态下降最多的下一个网络状态，同时确保收敛，本身就是一个组合优化问题。我们开发并使用了一个新工具来解决这个问题。我们将这个新工具称为离散微分滤波器（DDF），并在此基础上开发了一种新的同步动力学，称为SD-DDF（基于离散微分滤波器的同步动力学）。在本文中，我们回顾了Hopfield网络的原始异步动力学，并提出了一种新工具和一种新的同步动力学及其理论依据，并通过四个计算实验来经验性地评估处理时间的加速。
AI.summary: 本文针对Hopfield网络传统的异步更新方式，提出了一种名为离散微分滤波器（DDF）的新工具，并基于此开发了SD-DDF同步动力学。该方法通过在每个时间步同时更新多个神经元以实现最大能量下降，在确保网络收敛的同时大幅缩短了处理时间，并通过计算实验验证了其加速效果。
AI.keywords: Hopfield网络, 同步动力学, 离散微分滤波器, 组合优化, 能量极小化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将Hopfield网络的同步更新转化为组合优化问题，并提出了离散微分滤波器（DDF），在保证能量收敛的同时显著提升了计算速度，具有重要的理论和实际应用价值。

title: Baikal: Structured Search for Deep Research over Data Lakes
summary: Deep research over data lakes requires an LLM agent to investigate evidence across thousands of heterogeneous tables and passages to synthesize a report. Existing methods perform iterative retrieval and generation, letting accumulated context determine what to investigate next, which can overexploit locally promising evidence and fail to cover distinct semantic regions under a fixed budget. To address this, we cast deep research over data lakes as a budgeted search problem and present Baikal - a framework that clusters heterogeneous evidence into semantic regions, then searches over them adaptively to balance exploration and exploitation. Within each selected region, Baikal generates and investigates region-grounded subquestions, using finding quality as rewards to update region-level value estimates and guide search under policies ranging from random and LLM-guided selection to Bayesian $ε$-greedy and UCB. We evaluate Baikal on 15 queries each over HybridQA and TAT-QA data lakes containing 10,993 and 2,757 tables, respectively, together with 227K Wikipedia passages and 13K financial report passages. We assess research quality with a new rubric covering groundedness, relevance, diversity, and utility, and use GPT-5-mini to score Baikal and strong baselines, including DeepSearcher and an OpenCode research agent with retrieval and clustering variants. Across both data lakes, Baikal performs strongly under several region-selection policies; its best configuration improves report scores over the strongest baselines by 28% on HybridQA and 36% on TAT-QA. Our analyses attribute these gains to organizing and exploring semantic evidence regions, which improves groundedness and diversity and yields more useful findings under the same subquestion budget. These results demonstrate the value of structured semantic exploration for systematic research and discovery over heterogeneous data lakes.

AI.title_translation: 贝加尔湖：数据湖深度研究的结构化搜索
AI.tldr: Baikal是一个框架，它将数据湖中的异构证据聚类为语义区域，然后自适应地搜索这些区域以平衡探索和利用，从而在深度研究中显著提高报告质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在数据湖上进行深度研究时，通常采用迭代检索和生成，这可能过度利用局部有前景的证据，并在固定预算下未能覆盖不同的语义区域。
AI.method: Baikal将数据湖上的深度研究视为一个有预算的搜索问题。它将异构证据聚类成语义区域，然后自适应地搜索这些区域以平衡探索和利用。在每个选定的区域内，Baikal生成并调查区域相关子问题，使用发现质量作为奖励来更新区域级价值估计，并根据从随机、LLM引导选择到贝叶斯ε-贪婪和UCB等策略指导搜索。
AI.result: Baikal在HybridQA和TAT-QA数据湖上的表现优于最强的基线，报告分数分别提高了28%和36%。这些增益归因于组织和探索语义证据区域，这改善了基础性和多样性，并在相同的子问题预算下产生了更有用的发现。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语义探索对于异构数据湖上的系统研究和发现具有重要价值，Baikal框架通过平衡探索和利用显著提高了深度研究的质量。
AI.translation: 数据湖上的深度研究需要LLM代理调查数千个异构表格和段落中的证据以综合报告。现有方法执行迭代检索和生成，让累积的上下文决定下一步调查什么，这可能过度利用局部有前景的证据，并在固定预算下未能覆盖不同的语义区域。为了解决这个问题，我们将数据湖上的深度研究视为一个有预算的搜索问题，并提出了Baikal——一个将异构证据聚类为语义区域，然后自适应地搜索这些区域以平衡探索和利用的框架。在每个选定的区域内，Baikal生成并调查区域相关的子问题，使用发现质量作为奖励来更新区域级价值估计，并根据从随机、LLM引导选择到贝叶斯ε-贪婪和UCB的策略指导搜索。我们在HybridQA和TAT-QA数据湖上分别对15个查询评估了Baikal，这些数据湖分别包含10,993和2,757个表格，以及227K维基百科段落和13K财务报告段落。我们使用涵盖基础性、相关性、多样性和实用性的新评分标准评估研究质量，并使用GPT-5-mini对Baikal和强大的基线进行评分，包括DeepSearcher和带有检索和聚类变体的OpenCode研究代理。在这两个数据湖上，Baikal在几种区域选择策略下表现强劲；其最佳配置在HybridQA上将报告分数比最强基线提高了28%，在TAT-QA上提高了36%。我们的分析将这些增益归因于组织和探索语义证据区域，这改善了基础性和多样性，并在相同的子问题预算下产生了更有用的发现。这些结果证明了结构化语义探索对于异构数据湖上的系统研究和发现的价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Baikal框架，旨在解决数据湖上深度研究中现有方法过度利用局部证据和覆盖不足的问题。Baikal将深度研究视为一个有预算的搜索问题，通过将异构证据聚类成语义区域，并采用自适应策略平衡探索与利用。它在每个区域内生成子问题并评估发现质量以指导搜索。实验结果表明，Baikal在HybridQA和TAT-QA数据湖上显著优于现有基线，报告质量分别提升28%和36%，证明了结构化语义探索在异构数据湖深度研究中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 数据湖, 深度研究, LLM代理, 结构化搜索, 语义探索
AI.comments: Baikal通过引入结构化的语义区域探索，有效解决了传统迭代检索在数据湖深度研究中可能出现的局部最优和覆盖不足问题。其创新点在于将深度研究建模为预算搜索问题，并结合聚类、自适应探索-利用平衡策略以及LLM引导的子问题生成，为处理大规模异构数据提供了新的范式。该方法在实际应用中对于提高LLM代理在复杂数据环境下的研究报告质量具有重要意义。

title: A Graph Matching Based Approach for the Multi-Depot Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
summary: The Multi-Depot Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (MDCVRP) asks for minimum-cost delivery tours from several capacitated depots to a set of customers. Like most vehicle-routing variants it is NP-hard, so practical solvers must trade solution quality against speed. We revisit this trade-off through the lens of graph matching. Adapting a matching-based construction first developed for the Traveling Tournament Problem, we present two algorithms, Cluster-First and Match-First, that reduce routing to a sequence of minimum-weight matchings. This is more than a heuristic. We prove that for tours of up to two targets the matching formulation solves the MDCVRP exactly in polynomial time for any number of depots, and that both algorithms are constant-factor approximations, with a tight factor of two, in the structured regimes. This matching optimum coincides with the exact combinatorial-auction optimum, so the auction serves as a strong quality baseline. On instances of 1000 customers and 20 depots our methods match or slightly beat that baseline in tour length while running two to three orders of magnitude faster, in tens of milliseconds against tens of seconds, a scale at which exact and auction-based solvers become impractical. Because Cluster-First routes each depot independently, the approach also re-routes cheaply when new customers arrive.

AI.title_translation: 基于图匹配的多车场带容量限制车辆路径问题求解方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于图匹配的MDCVRP求解方法，在保证解质量的同时，将计算速度提升了数千倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的多车场带容量限制的车辆路径问题（MDCVRP）求解器在解的质量和速度之间存在权衡，而NP-hard的特性使得传统精确求解器在大规模实例下不切实际，因此需要开发速度更快且具备质量保证的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了两种算法（Cluster-First 和 Match-First），将车辆路径规划转化为一系列最小权图匹配问题，并将其与组合拍卖的最优解进行对比。
AI.result: 理论上证明了对于最多两个目标的路线，该匹配公式可在多项式时间内精确求解MDCVRP，且在结构化区域内具有紧确的2倍常数因子近似；在包含1000个客户和20个车场的大规模实例上，该方法在保持甚至略优于拍卖基准解质量的同时，运行速度提升了2到3个数量级（毫秒级对数十秒）。
AI.conclusion: 基于图匹配的算法为大规模MDCVRP提供了一种速度极快且质量极高的求解方案，兼具理论保证和实际应用潜力。
AI.translation: 多车场带容量限制车辆路径问题（MDCVRP）要求从几个有容量限制的车场到一组客户的最优成本配送路线。像大多数车辆路径变体一样，它是NP-hard的，因此实际求解器必须在解的质量和速度之间进行权衡。我们通过图匹配的视角重新审视这种权衡。通过改造最初为旅行锦标赛问题开发的基于匹配的构造方法，我们提出了两种算法，Cluster-First和Match-First，它们将路径规划简化为一系列最小权匹配。这不仅仅是一个启发式算法。我们证明了对于最多两个目标的路线，匹配公式可以在多项式时间内为任意数量的车场精确求解MDCVRP，并且这两种算法在结构化区域内都是常数因子近似算法，具有紧确的两倍近似因子。该匹配最优解与精确的组合拍卖最优解相吻合，因此拍卖可以作为强有力的质量基准。在包含1000个客户和20个车场的实例中，我们的方法在路线长度上匹配或略微优于该基准，同时运行速度快了2到3个数量级（在几十毫秒内，而精确和基于拍卖的求解器需要几十秒），在这一规模下，精确和基于拍卖的求解器变得不切实际。由于Cluster-First独立地为每个车场规划路线，当新客户到达时，该方法还可以以极低的成本重新规划路线。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于图匹配的方法来求解多车场带容量限制的车辆路径问题（MDCVRP），开发了Cluster-First和Match-First两种算法，将路径规划简化为最小权匹配序列。理论证明了其多项式时间精确求解能力和常数近似界，实验表明该方法在大规模实例上比传统求解器快数千倍且效果优异。
AI.keywords: 车辆路径问题, 多车场, 图匹配, 近似算法, 组合拍卖
AI.comments: 该论文将多车场带容量限制的车辆路径问题（MDCVRP）巧妙地转化为图匹配问题，不仅在理论上证明了其多项式时间和常数近似保证，而且在千级别客户的大规模实例上展现出了极高的计算效率，速度比传统方法快2-3个数量级，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Numerical Spectrum Linking: Identification of Governing PDE via Koopman-Chebyshev Approximation with Resampling
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing
summary: A numerical framework is proposed for identifying governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from observational data by establishing a link between observation-driven and equation-driven Koopman operators in a common Chebyshev spectral domain. In contrast to data-driven approaches such as dynamic mode decomposition (DMD), which approximate Koopman operators without explicitly relating them to differential operators, the proposed framework constructs finite-dimensional Koopman operators using Chebyshev spectral representations, thereby enabling direct comparison between data-derived dynamics and candidate governing PDEs. A unified observation model together with a least-squares coefficient recovery formulation is introduced to recover Chebyshev spectral coefficients from observations obtained on arbitrary sampling grids. This provides a numerically consistent interface between practical observations and Chebyshev-based Koopman analysis. Numerical experiments under direct Chebyshev, uniform, and irregular sampling configurations demonstrate that the proposed framework accurately identifies the governing PDE from observations. An observation-density study shows that reliable PDE identification is consistently achieved once sufficient independent observations are available for stable coefficient recovery, providing a practical guideline.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing

AI.title_translation: 数值谱链接：通过Koopman-切比雪夫近似与重采样识别控制偏微分方程
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种数值框架，通过在共同的切比雪夫谱域中连接观测驱动和方程驱动的Koopman算子，从观测数据中识别控制偏微分方程（PDE）。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法（如DMD）在近似Koopman算子时没有明确地将其与微分算子联系起来。本研究的动机是提供一个能够直接比较数据派生动力学和候选控制PDE的框架，从而识别控制PDE。
AI.method: 该框架通过建立观测驱动和方程驱动的Koopman算子在共同的切比雪夫谱域中的链接来识别控制PDE。它使用切比雪夫谱表示构建有限维Koopman算子，实现数据派生动力学与候选PDE的直接比较。引入统一的观测模型和最小二乘系数恢复公式，从任意采样网格上的观测数据中恢复切比雪夫谱系数。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，在直接切比雪夫、均匀和不规则采样配置下，所提出的框架能够准确地从观测数据中识别控制PDE。观测密度研究表明，一旦有足够的独立观测数据用于稳定的系数恢复，就能始终实现可靠的PDE识别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过连接Koopman算子在切比雪夫谱域中的表示，能够从观测数据中准确识别控制偏微分方程，并提供了一个实用的指导原则，即在有足够独立观测数据时可实现可靠识别。
AI.translation: 提出了一种数值框架，通过在共同的切比雪夫谱域中建立观测驱动和方程驱动的Koopman算子之间的链接，从观测数据中识别控制偏微分方程（PDE）。与动态模态分解（DMD）等数据驱动方法不同，后者在近似Koopman算子时没有明确地将其与微分算子关联，所提出的框架使用切比雪夫谱表示构建有限维Koopman算子，从而能够直接比较数据派生的动力学和候选控制PDE。引入了一个统一的观测模型以及一个最小二乘系数恢复公式，以从在任意采样网格上获得的观测数据中恢复切比雪夫谱系数。这为实际观测和基于切比雪夫的Koopman分析之间提供了一个数值上一致的接口。在直接切比雪夫、均匀和不规则采样配置下的数值实验表明，所提出的框架能够准确地从观测数据中识别控制PDE。一项观测密度研究表明，一旦有足够的独立观测数据用于稳定的系数恢复，就能始终实现可靠的PDE识别，从而提供了一个实用的指导原则。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为“数值谱链接”的框架，用于从观测数据中识别控制偏微分方程（PDE）。该方法通过在共同的切比雪夫谱域中建立观测驱动与方程驱动的Koopman算子之间的联系，并利用切比雪夫谱表示构建有限维Koopman算子，从而实现数据动力学与候选PDE的直接比较。结合统一观测模型和最小二乘法，该框架能从任意采样数据中恢复谱系数。数值实验证明了其在不同采样配置下准确识别PDE的能力，并指出足够的独立观测是实现可靠识别的关键。

title: PrintAnything: Learning an Intermediate Representation for 3D printing G-code Generation
summary: Point clouds are one of the most fundamental and widely used 3D representations, serving as the most basic geometric representation of 3D shapes. Nevertheless, most existing 3D printing pipelines require a watertight mesh as input, preventing the direct use of point clouds for fabrication. A common workaround is to reconstruct meshes from point clouds; however, the resulting meshes often contain geometric artifacts, such as incorrect faces or topological inconsistencies, that are difficult to repair and may lead to printing failures. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrintAnything, a novel framework that learns to produce executable 3D printing G-code directly from 3D point clouds without requiring mesh reconstruction. To enable point clouds to serve as direct input for slice-wise toolpath generation, we introduce a slice-wise point projection strategy that transforms unstructured 3D point clouds into slice-aligned 2D representations consistent with layer-by-layer nature of fused deposition modeling in 3D printing. To eliminate mesh dependency and provide a unified representation that bridges point clouds and G-code, we propose Geometric plan (G-plan) map, a compact 2D representation composed of occupancy, region, and flow maps that encode the geometric and extrusion properties required for toolpath synthesis in 3D printing. As a result, our proposed method accurately generates printable G-code directly from point clouds, enabling a practical and fully mesh-free pipeline for 3D printing. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}{https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything}.

AI.title_translation: PrintAnything：学习用于3D打印G代码生成的中间表示
AI.tldr: PrintAnything提出了一种无网格的3D打印框架，通过学习中间表示（G-plan地图），能够直接将3D点云转化为可执行的G代码。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D打印流程大多要求输入为封闭网格（watertight mesh），直接使用点云时通常需要进行网格重建，但这往往会引入几何伪影和拓扑不一致性，难以修复且易导致打印失败；因此，需要开发一种直接从3D点云生成G代码的无网格框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种切片式点投影策略（将非结构化点云转化为切片对齐的2D表示）以及几何平面（G-plan）地图（由占用、区域和流向图组成，用于编码几何和挤出属性），从而无需网格重建即可直接从点云合成工具路径。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够从点云中准确生成可打印的G代码，实现了一个实用且完全无网格的3D打印流水线。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功开发了PrintAnything框架，通过引入切片式点投影策略和几何平面（G-plan）地图，实现了直接从3D点云到可执行3D打印G代码的无网格端到端生成，极大地简化了3D打印流程。
AI.translation: 点云是最基础且广泛使用的3D表示之一，可作为3D形状最基本的几何表达。然而，现有的绝大多数3D打印流水线都需要封闭网格作为输入，阻碍了点云在制造中的直接应用。常见的变通方法是从点云重建网格；然而，生成的网格通常包含几何伪影（如错误的面或拓扑不一致），这些伪影很难修复并可能导致打印失败。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了PrintAnything，一个新颖的框架，它无需网格重建即可直接从3D点云生成可执行的3D打印G代码。为了让点云充当切片式刀具路径生成的直接输入，我们引入了一种切片式点投影策略，将非结构化3D点云转化为与3D打印中熔融沉积建模的逐层特性相一致的切片对齐2D表示。为了消除对网格的依赖并提供一个桥接点云与G代码的统一表示，我们提出了几何平面（G-plan）地图，这是一种由占用、区域和流向图组成的紧凑2D表示，编码了3D打印中刀具路径合成所需的几何和挤出属性。因此，我们提出的方法能够直接从点云精确生成可打印的G代码，实现了一个实用且完全无网格的3D打印流水线。代码已在https://github.com/Sangminhong/PrintAnything公开。

title: Towards joint scaling laws with optimal batch size schedules
summary: Modern deep learning typically keeps the batch size static throughout training, thus overlooking the joint effect of learning rate and batch size on the training dynamics. In this paper, we study the deep learning dynamics through the lens of convex optimization and derive a joint characterization of loss in terms of both schedules, applicable to general optimizers and model architectures. This characterization yields a closed-form optimal batch size schedule for any prescribed learning rate schedule, and further leads to joint scaling laws that consistently outperform static batch size baselines, highlighting the significance of dynamic batch size schedule in large language model training.

title: VeriSkill: A Self-Evolution Framework for Program Verification Skills
summary: Automating program verification with LLM agents requires generating specifications, annotations, auxiliary lemmas, and tool invocations, all of which depend on reusable skills. A natural remedy is skill self-evolution: distilling skills from trajectories and refining them through feedback. However, existing evolution methods struggle with program verification tasks because they cannot reliably identify skill-specific failures or extract actionable signals from opaque verifier feedback. In this paper, we propose VeriSkill, a self-evolution framework built for program verification. It attributes verification failures to skill deficiencies, distills diagnostic signatures into reusable lessons, and iteratively refines candidate skills, admitting only revisions that improve verification performance while preserving program semantics. Experiments show that VeriSkill consistently outperforms all baselines across multiple verification tools, agent frameworks, and LLM backends.

title: A Sparse Glimpse of the Whole: Train-Free Self-Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding alleviates the memory-bandwidth bottleneck in large language model inference, but its acceleration is jointly constrained by drafting overhead, token acceptance, and speculation length. We present a unified efficiency analysis showing that extending the speculation horizon can reduce rather than improve speedup when the marginal acceptance probability falls below the relative drafting cost. Guided by this analysis, we introduce SparseSpec-L, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework for long-context inference. SparseSpec-L generates lightweight drafts directly from the target model using a dynamically sparsified and recallable KV cache. It recycles per-head attention statistics produced during full-context verification as a no-extra-forward importance signal, allowing critical historical tokens to be recalled without permanently discarding the dense KV cache. An online entropy-based controller further selects the speculation length according to expected step-wise efficiency. Experiments across multiple long-context tasks and model scales show consistent end-to-end acceleration, with up to speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

title: An Asymptotic-Preserving Dynamical Low-Rank Semi-Lagrangian Method for Multiscale Linear Kinetic Transport Equations
summary: In this paper, we develop an asymptotic-preserving (AP) dynamical low-rank semi-Lagrangian method for multiscale linear kinetic transport equations. The method combines the large-time-step capability of semi-Lagrangian discretizations with the storage and cost reduction provided by low-rank representations. The proposed scheme couples an approximate macroscopic density update with the basis update Galerkin integrator for the kinetic distribution. To retain the reduced complexity in the semi-Lagrangian flux evaluation, the flux derivative is computed through a sampled angular quadrature strategy. We establish an unconditional stability analysis of the full-quadrature low-rank scheme in the constant-coefficient case. The error induced by angular sampling in the flux derivative is quantified. The resulting scheme is shown to be AP in the diffusive limit. Numerical experiments, including high-dimensional test cases, demonstrate that the proposed method is AP, stable under large time steps, and computationally efficient across kinetic and diffusive regimes.

title: Improving the Robustness/Accuracy Tradeoff Against Adversarial Attacks Using Information Bottleneck Distillation Through Dual Teachers
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in classical machine learning problems. However, they are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Countermeasures proposed in the literature, notably Information Bottleneck Distillation (IBD) introduced by Kuang et al., degrade the classification accuracy on clean inputs while improving the robustness to adversarial inputs. In this work, we extend the IBD framework by introducing an extra teacher model (clean teacher) trained with only clean inputs, into the distillation process from a robust teacher model trained by adversarial training. The features of both clean and robust teachers are transferred to the student through a cross-layer attention matrix. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets show that the proposed method improves classification accuracy on clean samples compared to the original IBD, while maintaining similar accuracy on adversarial samples. Furthermore, our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art approaches, including the recent dual-teacher distillation framework B-MTARD, particularly in terms of the harmonic mean between clean and robust accuracy. We also analyze the impact of different training settings that have different influences on the attention module.

title: Measuring Alignment With Reader Highlights Net of Position and Length
comments: 15 pages, 7 tables. Analysis code and de-identified artifacts included as ancillary files; five of six scripts reproduce the paper's numbers from the shipped artifacts alone. Reports claims from our own prior work that this corpus does not reproduce, and lists twelve claims withdrawn during internal adversarial review in Appendix A
summary: Context compression discards most of a document before a language model reads it, and is normally evaluated by downstream task accuracy - which makes another model the judge of what mattered. Naturalistic social highlighting offers a non-circular reference: many people independently marking passages on the same page. But the obvious metric, the fraction of crowd-marked sentences a compressor keeps, is confounded twice: crowd marks are front-loaded and crowd-marked sentences are longer, so any method favouring early or long sentences scores well regardless of readers. We remove both by matching each marked sentence against unmarked sentences of the same document at equal relative depth and equal within-document length rank, and we calibrate every estimator on synthetic nulls built from position and length alone - a step that matters, since depth-only stratification returns a false positive on 20-36% of nulls containing no effect. On 120 web documents (at least 12 independent readers each), a language-model importance ranking keeps 38.4% of crowd-marked sentences against 19.9% of their matched neighbours: an enrichment of +0.196 [+0.148, +0.239], at p = 0.0005 under an exact randomization test that assumes nothing about clustering, and replicated cross-vendor. Naive truncation, whose keep rule is position, correctly falls to +0.003. To give the number a scale: scored identically, on the same budget, against a crowd label recomputed to exclude them, a single human reader reaches +0.182 - indistinguishable from GPT-5.4 (+0.002 [-0.081, +0.088]) and below Claude Opus 5. Classical methods are not null - Luhn's 1958 heuristic reaches +0.088 - so reader selection is partly recoverable by counting words; conditioning additionally on lexical centrality removes only 0.010, so the agreement is not centrality. We also report that a claim in our own prior work does not reproduce on this corpus.

title: Chance-Constrained Nonlinear Covariance Control via Robust Linearization Remainder Bounds
comments: Accepted to 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: When dealing with nonlinear systems, classical covariance steering typically propagates uncertainty via first-order linearizations, discarding higher-order Taylor remainders. This truncation causes computed statistical moments to diverge from the true physical state distribution, often leading to chance constraint violations. This paper introduces a discrete-time Sequential Convex Programming (SCP) framework that casts the deterministic one-step nonlinear numerical map as a Linear Stochastic Inclusion. The Taylor remainder is bounded within an unstructured uncertainty block over a uniform envelope. The second-moment tubes are propagated via what we refer to as a robust Stochastic Linear Matrix Inequality (S-LMI) derived from the Petersen's lemma, providing an upper bound on the expected uncentered second moment. Domain-exit risk is bounded analytically via a Markov trace inequality, and spatial chance constraints are enforced via Gauss unimodal second-moment bounds within a Difference-of-Convex program. Simulations on a state-dependent nonlinear dynamic system demonstrate constraint satisfaction.
comment: Accepted to 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control

title: Delegated Fair Division
summary: Motivated by recently introduced problems on delegated resource allocation, we study a model of fair division, where a set of indivisible goods is to be allocated to some agents, each of which belonging to some bigger central entity. Our model captures the general framework of allocating resources to organizational units, which subsequently distribute them to their affiliated members. A particularly relevant application of this framework, with immense social impact, arises in the allocation of food donations through charitable organizations. In essence, every center acts as the representative of the agents belonging to it, aligning their generally different preferences. Our goal is to distribute the goods in a way that is simultaneously fair both with respect to the centers and the agents. We distinguish two different information structures depending on whether the agents compare their bundles against every agent or only those belonging to the same center. For each one of them we provide efficient algorithms that produce allocations that satisfy envy-based fairness guarantees at both levels.

title: ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation
summary:
Modern recommendation models gain prediction quality by scaling feature-interaction and sequence modules, but production cost constraints cap how far systems can scale.
  In this work, we propose Request-Oriented Compute Sharing (ROCS), a modeling and inference paradigm that exploits a unique property of recommendation inference: each user request is evaluated against many candidates, while request-side features are shared across candidates. ROCS defers request-candidate interactions as late as possible, isolates candidate-dependent representations, and evaluates substantial portions of the model once per request rather than once per candidate, significantly improving inference efficiency while maintaining or improving prediction quality. To realize this paradigm, we develop Generalized Layer Masking (GLM) to enforce candidate isolation in feature-interaction architectures, and Deep Cross Attention (DCA) to extend request-oriented sharing to sequence architectures. To support efficient GPU deployment, we co-design In-Kernel Broadcast Optimization (IKBO) that significantly accelerates ROCS model execution.
  Experiments on public benchmarks show that ROCS consistently improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff across recommendation backbones. On production-scale workloads, ROCS achieves up to a 3x QPS improvement on retrieval models without quality degradation and a 0.5% relative LogLoss improvement with a 50% QPS gain on a short-form video ranking model. ROCS has been deployed across large-scale recommendation systems spanning ads and organic surfaces, retrieval and ranking stages, and more than two orders of magnitude in inference complexity, delivering significant online gains at reduced infrastructure cost.

title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
summary: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Visual illusions are phenomena in which the human visual system misinterprets objective signals, resulting in an understanding that deviates from reality. We constructed IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of illusion images collected from the real world, incorporating diverse annotated question-answer pairs. Based on IllusionReasoning, we show that the reasoning capabilities of a wide range of LVLMs are not as advanced as claimed. Our work provides new insights into LVLMs and offers future direction for optimisation.

title: A Structured Knowledge Infrastructure for Domain-Specific Data Asset Discovery
comments: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to DAI 2026 Industry Track
summary: Enterprise data analytics agents face two structural failures: generic RAG retrieves the wrong asset (Hit@10=19.1%) and delivers no usage knowledge to prevent metric misinterpretation---stemming from four root causes (C1--C4) ranging from semantic gap and entity ambiguity to schema drift and asset-usage gap. We present a two-layer solution deployed in the commercial advertising data warehouse at Xiaohongshu (5,300+ Hive tables, 14 domains). A three-tier dual-purpose knowledge base (179 documents, eight-section annotation template) serves both retrieval and generation, with a closed-loop refresh pipeline maintaining day-level freshness (one yes/no approval, 30s hot-reload). The Graph-Guided Retriever (GGR) uses a 2,859-node knowledge graph as a candidate gate with intent routing to deliver 71.6x token reduction. The Scene-Aware Ranker (SAR) applies 19-class entity recognition and explicit scenario annotations; negative knowledge alone contributes 25 percentage points of Hit@10 gain. On two 100-question benchmarks, Hit@10 rises from 19.1% to 96.6% (+77.5pp) and knowledge coverage from 56% to 77%, at 4.84--5.33s end-to-end latency.
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to DAI 2026 Industry Track

title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
summary: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues. Our framework adopts an explicit mesh as an intermediate representation for cross-model verification and fusion, reconciling noisy outputs from vision-language and segmentation models into spatially consistent part structures. To estimate joint parameters without observed motion, we use a video diffusion model to synthesize articulation hypotheses and validate them through geometric consistency. Our approach achieves accurate part decomposition and physically plausible articulation, performing competitively with motion-observing reconstruction-based, generation-based, and modular pretrained-model baselines.

title: EgoGVAE: Ego-body Mesh Reconstruction via Guided Variational Autoencoder
summary: We address the problem of recovering the full-body mesh from only the head pose. This task has become essential for various applications based on head-mounted devices or smart glasses. The challenge of this task lies in estimating the pose information of unobserved body parts based solely on a single joint (i.e., head) trajectory. Several studies have begun to adopt head-conditioned generative models, however, such previous methods are costly and time-consuming due to the diffusion-based iterative process. As an alternative, we propose a simple yet novel method that leverages the latent space of the guidance network, which is designed as a variational autoencoder taking full-body poses as inputs. By enforcing latent distributions of this guidance network and our head-to-motion network to be similar, latent features sampled from the 'guided' distribution, i.e., distribution learned in our head-to-motion network, can be reliably decoded for natural representations of full-body poses even only with the head pose. One important advantage of the proposed method is that one-step sampling scheme achieves remarkably fast inference (more than 50 times faster) compared to diffusion-based approaches. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that the proposed method efficiently improves the performance of ego-body mesh reconstruction.

title: Cocktail-Talker: Multi-Speaker Dialog Modeling in Noisy Social Environments with Turn Action GRPO
summary: Spoken dialog systems are typically designed for clean, dyadic interactions in which a single user and an assistant take turns speaking. Real-world social conversations, however, are often more ambiguous: multiple speakers may participate in the same conversation amid irrelevant speech and background noise. Each utterance may be directed to the assistant, addressed to another speaker, or completely irrelevant. In such settings, the assistant must decide not only what to say, but also whether to speak at all. In this paper, we introduce Cocktail-Talker, a speech LLM framework for multi-speaker spoken dialog modeling in noisy social environments. We model the assistant's behavior with three action tokens: <|respond|>, <|listen|>, and <|ignore|>, placed before a response or silence. Cocktail-Talker is trained via supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning to generate the appropriate action token and, only in <|respond|> mode, a speech response. To prepare the training data, we develop Cocktail-DialogGen, an LLM-based data pipeline that simulates realistic multi-speaker dialogs with speaker roles across diverse social settings. Together, these components take a step toward spoken dialog systems that interact more naturally and selectively in complex social environments.

title: Hierarchical Latent Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation by leveraging their semantic understanding and contextual modeling capabilities. Recent studies further introduce reasoning mechanisms to improve user preference modeling. However, explicit natural-language reasoning incurs substantial inference overhead, whereas existing latent reasoning methods mainly focus on generating or verifying intermediate states, leaving their layer-wise preference roles and contributions insufficiently characterized. We propose HiLaR, a Hierarchical Latent Reasoning framework with layer-aware reinforcement optimization for LLM-based recommendation. HiLaR constructs temporal-guided hierarchical user preference representations, aligns them with multiple LLM latent reasoning states, and organizes the reasoning process from broad preferences to fine-grained current intents. To further optimize the reasoning trajectory, HiLaR combines final recommendation feedback with layer-aware process rewards derived from the marginal target-likelihood gain of each state. Experiments on four Amazon benchmark datasets show that HiLaR generally outperforms strong sequential, generative, and LLM-based recommendation baselines. Ablation and sensitivity analyses further verify the contribution of hierarchical representation learning, latent alignment, and process-level optimization. Our code is available in https://github.com/hupeiyu21/HiLaR.

AI.title_translation: 基于大语言模型的层级隐式推理推荐
AI.tldr: 本文提出HiLaR框架，结合层级隐式推理与层感知强化学习优化，有效提升了基于大语言模型推荐的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 显式自然语言推理在LLM推荐中会带来巨大的计算与时间开销，而现有的隐式推理方法侧重于生成或验证中间状态，未能充分表征和利用各层级偏好在推理过程中的不同作用与贡献。
AI.method: 提出了HiLaR框架：1）构建时序引导的层级用户偏好表示，并将其与LLM的多个隐式推理状态对齐，按从宏观偏好到细粒度意图的顺序组织推理；2）结合最终推荐反馈与基于各状态边际目标似然增益的层感知过程奖励，通过强化学习优化推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个Amazon基准数据集上的实验表明，HiLaR性能整体优于强顺序推荐、生成式推荐及LLM推荐基线模型；消融与敏感性实验证实了层级表示、隐式对齐及过程优化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HiLaR通过结合层级隐式推理与层感知过程奖励优化，有效地在降低推理开销的同时提升了LLM在推荐任务中的偏好建模能力与推荐精度。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）凭借其强大的语义理解和上下文建模能力，在推荐系统中展现出巨大潜力。近期的研究进一步引入推理机制以改进用户偏好建模。然而，显式自然语言推理会带来巨大的推理开销，而现有的隐式推理方法主要集中于生成或验证中间状态，未能充分刻画其逐层偏好的角色与贡献。为此，我们提出了HiLaR——一种带有层感知强化优化的层级隐式推理框架，用于基于LLM的推荐。HiLaR构建了时序引导的层级用户偏好表示，将其与多个LLM隐式推理状态对齐，并将推理过程组织为从宽泛偏好到细粒度当前意图的递进形态。为了进一步优化推理轨迹，HiLaR将最终推荐反馈与派生自每个状态边际目标似然增益的层感知过程奖励相结合。在四个Amazon基准数据集上的实验表明，HiLaR整体优于强顺序推荐、生成式推荐以及基于LLM的推荐基线。消融和敏感性分析进一步验证了层级表示学习、隐式对齐和过程级优化的贡献。我们的代码开源于：https://github.com/hupeiyu21/HiLaR。
AI.summary: 针对基于LLM推荐中显式推理开销大、现有隐式推理缺乏逐层偏好刻画的问题，本文提出了HiLaR框架。HiLaR通过构建时序引导的层级偏好并与LLM隐状态对齐，将推理过程显式组织为从宏观偏好到微观意图的递进路径，并结合基于边际似然增益的过程奖励进行强化优化，在多个真实数据集上取得了优异效果。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型推荐, 隐式推理, 层级偏好表示, 强化学习优化, 过程奖励
AI.comments: 本文创新地将隐式推理与强化学习的过程奖励（Process Reward）相结合，既克服了显式自然语言推理的高时延问题，又通过层级偏好对齐赋予了隐状态从宏观偏好到微观意图的明确逻辑结构。局限性在于层级偏好的构建依赖于时序引导规则，在非时序或极端稀疏的推荐场景下的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: DAS-PMVC: A Framework for Partial Multi-View Clustering via Dual Alignment and Structure Enhancement
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: In recent years, multi-view clustering has attracted widespread research interest. However, due to limitations in data collection devices, data across different views often suffer from misalignment, leading to the partial view alignment problem (PVAP). To mitigate the impact of view asymmetry and irrelevant samples, this paper proposes a framework for partial multi-view clustering via dual alignment and structure enhancement (DAS-PMVC), which leverages view structure consistency and semantic relevance. Specifically, DAS-PMVC includes three parts: \textbf{anchor graph structure alignment}, where sample joint embedding representations with consistent latent space are derived from anchor point relationships for initial view alignment; \textbf{structure-enhanced feature learning}, where the model learns view structure information through pretraining and combines multi-view graph convolutional networks to further extract deep latent features from the aligned graph structure to improve the discriminative power of representations; and \textbf{a dual alignment strategy}, where initial alignment is performed through the anchor graph in the pretraining phase, and contrastive learning loss and the Hungarian algorithm are introduced in the training phase to further optimize the alignment of latent features. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that the DAS-PMVC framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in clustering performance, showcasing its effectiveness and superiority.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026

AI.title_translation: DAS-PMVC：一种基于双重对齐与结构增强的部分多视图聚类框架
AI.tldr: DAS-PMVC框架结合锚图结构对齐、多视图GCN与双重对齐策略（对比学习+匈牙利算法），有效解决了部分多视图数据未对齐的聚类难题。
AI.motivation: 在实际多视图数据采集过程中，受设备和环境等限制，不同视图的数据常存在未对齐问题（部分视图对齐问题，PVAP），导致视图不对称和无关样本干扰，进而降低聚类性能。
AI.method:
DAS-PMVC框架包含三个核心模块：
1. 锚图结构对齐：利用锚点关系导出具有一致潜空间的样本联合嵌入表示，完成初始视图对齐；
2. 结构增强特征学习：通过预训练捕获结构信息，结合多视图图卷积网络（GCN）提取深层潜在特征；
3. 双重对齐策略：预训练阶段基于锚图实现初始对齐，训练阶段结合对比学习损失和匈牙利算法进一步优化潜在特征的精细对齐。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的对比实验结果表明，DAS-PMVC在聚类性能指标上均优于现有的最新（SOTA）方法，验证了该方法的有效性与优越性。
AI.conclusion: DAS-PMVC框架通过结合视图结构一致性与语义相关性，成功克服了多视图聚类中的视图未对齐和不对称问题，显著提升了潜在特征的判别力与聚类效果。
AI.translation: 近年来，多视图聚类引起了广泛的研究兴趣。然而，由于数据采集设备的限制，不同视图的数据往往存在未对齐的情况，从而导致部分视图对齐问题（PVAP）。为了减轻视图不对称性和无关样本的影响，本文提出了一种基于双重对齐与结构增强的部分多视图聚类框架（DAS-PMVC），该框架利用了视图结构一致性和语义相关性。具体而言，DAS-PMVC 包含三个部分：锚图结构对齐，从锚点关系中导出具有一致潜在空间的样本联合嵌入表示，用于初始视图对齐；结构增强特征学习，模型通过预训练学习视图结构信息，并结合多视图图卷积网络，进一步从对齐的图结构中提取深层潜在特征，以提高表示的判别能力；以及双重对齐策略，在预训练阶段通过锚图进行初始对齐，并在训练阶段引入对比学习损失和匈牙利算法，以进一步优化潜在特征的对齐。在各种数据集上的实验结果表明，DAS-PMVC 框架在聚类性能上优于现有的最新方法，展示了其有效性和优越性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多视图聚类中的部分视图未对齐问题（PVAP），提出了DAS-PMVC框架。该框架利用视图结构一致性与语义相关性，通过锚图结构对齐、GCN结构增强特征学习以及结合对比学习和匈牙利算法的双重对齐策略，显著提升了深层潜在特征的判别力与聚类准确率。
AI.keywords: 多视图聚类, 部分视图对齐, 锚图结构, 图卷积网络, 双重对齐
AI.comments:
创新性：该论文提出了DAS-PMVC框架，创新性地将锚图结构对齐、多视图图卷积网络（GCN）、对比学习以及匈牙利算法结合，建立了双重对齐机制，同时从拓扑结构和语义特征层面解决了多视图数据未对齐问题。
重要性：针对数据采集设备受限导致的实际部分视图未对齐（PVAP）难题，提供了更优的聚类解决方案，具有较高的实际应用价值。
局限性：摘要中未对模型的计算复杂度以及在极端缺失/高噪声数据下的鲁棒性进行详细说明。

title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmedical 2026: Architectural Diversity for Concept Detection and Foundation-Model Scaling for Caption Prediction in Medical Image Analysis
summary: We describe the DS@GT submissions to the ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 challenge, which continues a long-running benchmark on the ROCOv2 dataset with two tracks: Concept Detection (Task 1), assigning UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers (CUIs) to radiology images, and Caption Prediction (Task 2), generating natural-language captions. For Task 1, our primary submission was a three-way late-fusion ensemble of ConvNeXt-V2, BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16, and DenseNet-169 with a regularized ''Honest Threshold Tuning'' procedure designed to avoid validation overfitting on rare concepts; this submission ranked first on the official submission with a primary $F_1$ of $0.5790$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9657$. In parallel, we submitted a training-free KNN retrieval pipeline over frozen BiomedCLIP embeddings, which reached a primary $F_1$ of $0.5780$ and a secondary $F_1$ of $0.9599$-essentially matching the fine-tuned ensemble on the primary track at a fraction of the cost. For Task 2, our submissions included a fine-tuned Gemma-3 27B model (overall $0.3571$, ranking third in the official submission), a fully fine-tuned BLIP pipeline with custom Vizwins merging ($0.3564$), and a zero-shot MedGemma-4B run with a PubMed-style prompt ($0.3186$), spanning a wide range of model scales and training costs. Code: https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-caption-2026.

AI.title_translation: DS@GT ARC 在 ImageCLEFmedical 2026：用于概念检测的架构多样性与用于医学图像分析中图文生成的基础模型扩展
AI.tldr: 团队在 ImageCLEFmedical 2026 比赛中，通过多架构集成/免训练KNN检索（概念检测）与基础大模型微调及扩展（图文生成），分别取得了第一名和第三名的优异成绩。
AI.motivation: 针对 ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 挑战赛中的医学图像概念检测与自然语言描述生成两大任务，探索不同网络架构多样性融合、计算成本优化（免训练检索）以及大语言基础模型扩展对医学多模态理解与生成性能的影响。
AI.method:
1. 概念检测（任务1）：提出一种结合 ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16 和 DenseNet-169 的三路晚期融合集成模型，并采用正则化的“诚实阈值调优”（Honest Threshold Tuning）防止稀有概念过拟合；同时设计了一种基于冻结 BiomedCLIP 嵌入的免训练 KNN 检索管道。
2. 图文生成（任务2）：评估了三种方案，包括微调 Gemma-3 27B 大模型、结合自定义 Vizwins 合并的全微调 BLIP 管道，以及采用 PubMed 风格提示词的零样本 MedGemma-4B 模型。
AI.result:
1. 任务1（概念检测）：三路晚期融合集成模型在官方提交中斩获第一名（主 F1 为 0.5790，次 F1 为 0.9657）；免训练 KNN 检索管道主 F1 达到 0.5780（次 F1 为 0.9599），以极低成本取得了逼近微调模型的性能。
2. 任务2（图文生成）：微调 Gemma-3 27B 模型取得 0.3571 的综合得分（官方排名第三），全微调 BLIP 管道得分为 0.3564，零样本 MedGemma-4B 得分为 0.3186。
AI.conclusion: 多样化的模型架构融合与恰当的阈值调优策略对于医学多标签概念检测极为关键，且免训练的特征检索方法能以极低成本达到顶尖性能；在医学图文生成任务中，扩展基础模型规模并配合针对性的微调或提示工程能够大幅提升生成质量。
AI.translation: 我们描述了 DS@GT 团队在 ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 挑战赛中的参赛方案。该挑战赛延续了基于 ROCOv2 数据集的长效基准，包含两个赛道：概念检测（任务 1），即为放射学图像分配 UMLS 概念唯一标识符（CUI）；以及图文生成（任务 2），即生成自然语言描述。对于任务 1，我们的主要提交是一个包含 ConvNeXt-V2、BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16 和 DenseNet-169 的三路晚期融合集成模型，并采用了旨在避免在稀有概念上对验证集过拟合的正则化“诚实阈值调优”流程；该提交在官方评估中排名第一，主 F1 为 0.5790，次 F1 为 0.9657。与此同时，我们提交了一个基于冻结 BiomedCLIP 嵌入的免训练 KNN 检索管道，其主 F1 达到 0.5780，次 F1 达到 0.9599——以极小的成本基本达到了与微调集成模型相当的主赛道性能。对于任务 2，我们的提交包括微调的 Gemma-3 27B 模型（综合得分 0.3571，官方排名第三）、结合自定义 Vizwins 合并的全微调 BLIP 管道（0.3564），以及采用 PubMed 风格提示词的零样本 MedGemma-4B 运行（0.3186），跨越了广泛的模型规模和训练成本。代码地址：https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-caption-2026。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 DS@GT 团队参加 ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2026 挑战赛的方案。在概念检测任务中，团队利用多架构集成与阈值调优夺得冠军，并证明了免训练 KNN 检索的高效性；在图文生成任务中，通过探索不同规模的基础模型（如 Gemma-3 27B、BLIP、MedGemma-4B），取得了官方第三名的成绩。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分析, 概念检测, 图文生成, BiomedCLIP, 基础模型
AI.comments:
创新性与重要性：本文展现了架构多样性（结合CNN与ViT/CLIP模型）在医学图像多标签概念检测中的显著成效，其提出的“诚实阈值调优”有效缓解了稀有概念的过拟合问题。此外，免训练的 BiomedCLIP KNN 检索以极低的算力成本取得了与微调集成模型相当的性能，极具实用价值。在图文生成方面，探索了不同规模（4B到27B）基础模型的适用性。
局限性：摘要中未详细说明“诚实阈值调优”的算法实现机制，且缺乏对各类模型在实际临床部署时的推理延时与显存开销的全面对比。

title: Private Face Recognition Training Dataset Publication via Identity-Decoupled and Geometry-Preserving Face Distillation
summary: Publishing private face recognition~(FR) training datasets is privacy-sensitive because faces expose identity information. Private FR training dataset publication mitigates this risk by releasing protected proxies as substitutes for private training faces. However, training FR models with such data introduces an identity paradox: \emph{the identity cues that make released faces useful for recognition supervision are also the cues that make them linkable to real individuals.} A protected face should be decoupled from the original identity, yet still behave as a reliable identity sample for training. Removing these cues too aggressively may destroy the class structure needed for recognition learning, whereas preserving them too faithfully may increase source-identity linkability. We argue that this paradox stems from conflating source-aligned identity semantics with recognition-useful proxy identity geometry. The former should be suppressed to reduce linkage to private individuals, while the latter should be preserved for FR learning. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{Private Face Distillation}, an identity-decoupling and geometry-preserving framework. It uses Orthogonal Geometry Preservation to construct decoupled proxy identities from private identity representations while maintaining hyperspherical geometry, and Relational Topology Alignment to preserve identity relations for recognition learning. Experiments across multiple domain-shifted FR scenarios show that Private Face Distillation achieves stronger utility than the evaluated publication baselines. On IJB-C surveillance, it improves $\mathrm{TAR}@\mathrm{FAR}{=}1\text{e-}{3}$ by 3.94\% over the baseline while reducing source-identity linkability. These results suggest that private FR training dataset publication should decouple source-identity correspondence while preserving proxy identity geometry.

AI.title_translation: 基于身份解耦与几何保持人脸蒸馏的私有人脸识别训练数据集发布
AI.tldr: 本文提出“私有人脸蒸馏”框架，通过解耦源身份语义并保留代理身份几何拓扑，成功解决了私有人脸识别数据集发布中隐私保护与训练实用性之间的“身份悖论”。
AI.motivation: 发布私有人脸识别数据集存在严重的隐私泄露风险。采用受保护的代理数据训练模型时存在“身份悖论”：用于监督识别学习的身份线索同时也会增加其与真实个人关联的风险。过于激进地删除身份线索会破坏类结构，过度保留又会增加隐私关联。本文指出这一矛盾源于混淆了“源对齐身份语义”（需抑制）与“识别有用的代理身份几何”（需保留）。
AI.method: 提出了“私有人脸蒸馏”（Private Face Distillation）框架，包含两个核心机制：1) 正交几何保持（Orthogonal Geometry Preservation），从私有身份表示中构建解耦的代理身份，同时保持超球面几何结构；2) 关系拓扑对齐（Relational Topology Alignment），保留身份间的拓扑关系以有效监督人脸识别模型的训练。
AI.result: 在多个跨领域人脸识别场景下，该方法的实用性均显著优于现有的发布基线。在 IJB-C 监控数据集上，TAR@FAR=1e-3 相比基线提升了 3.94%，同时有效降低了与源身份的可链接性。
AI.conclusion: 私有人脸识别训练数据集发布应当在解耦源身份对应关系（降低隐私关联风险）的同时，充分保留代理身份的特征空间几何结构，从而兼顾隐私保护与识别模型的训练实用性。
AI.translation: 发布私有人脸识别（FR）训练数据集具有高度的隐私敏感性，因为人脸会泄露个人身份信息。私有人脸识别训练数据集发布通过释放受保护的代理数据作为私有训练人脸的替代品来缓解这一风险。然而，使用此类数据训练人脸识别模型会引发“身份悖论”：使得发布的代理人脸能够有效监督识别训练的身份线索，恰恰也是导致它们能够链接到真实个人的线索。受保护的人脸应当与原始身份解耦，同时仍能作为可靠的身份样本用于训练。过分激进地消除这些线索可能会破坏识别学习所需的类结构，而过于忠实地保留它们则会增加与源身份的关联性。我们认为，这一悖论源于混淆了源对齐的身份语义与识别有用的代理身份几何。前者应当被抑制以减少与私有个人的关联，而后者应当被保留以用于人脸识别学习。基于这一洞察，我们提出了“私有人脸蒸馏”（Private Face Distillation），这是一个身份解耦与几何保持的框架。它利用正交几何保持从私有身份表示中构建解耦的代理身份，同时维持超球面几何关系；并利用关系拓扑对齐保留身份关系以用于识别学习。在多个存在域迁移的人脸识别场景下的实验表明，私有人脸蒸馏比评估的发布基线展现出更强的实用性。在 IJB-C 监控数据集上，它在降低源身份关联度的同时，将 TAR@FAR=1e-3 相比基线提升了 3.94%。这些结果表明，私有人脸识别训练数据集发布应当解耦源身份对应关系，同时保留代理身份几何。
AI.summary: 本文针对私有人脸识别数据集发布中“隐私保护与训练效能不可兼得”的身份悖论，提出了“私有人脸蒸馏”框架。该框架通过区分并抑制源身份语义，同时利用正交几何保持与关系拓扑对齐保留代理身份的几何特征和拓扑结构，在降低真实身份关联风险的同时显著提升了生成数据训练人脸识别模型的准确率。
AI.keywords: 私有人脸识别, 数据集发布, 身份解耦, 人脸蒸馏, 几何保持
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地指出了私有人脸数据发布中“源身份语义”与“代理身份几何”的差异，突破了传统方法在隐私保护与模型训练效能之间的对立关系。提出的“私有人脸蒸馏”框架在理论上有较强的说服力，实验效果提升明显，对人脸识别领域的隐私保护数据集发布具有重要实用价值。局限性在于主要在域迁移及监控场景下验证，对更复杂攻击手段下的隐私安全界限尚需进一步评估。

title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
summary: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects complementary encoder layers, constructs an output-derived conditioning space from candidate memory, and aligns candidate input representations to this space through closed-form ridge regression. Low-rank factorization then produces a compact retrieval basis where candidate outputs are used only during offline index construction, whereas query-time retrieval requires only the query input and precomputed index. We show that CoRA's rank-constrained basis is the optimal low-rank compression of the output-conditioned fitted representation, and derive an exact two-pass streaming construction that avoids materializing the full fitted matrix. We further extend the framework to multimodal exemplar retrieval by incorporating visual representations into the conditioning and retrieval spaces. Experiments across ten textual datasets and four multimodal benchmarks with Llama-3.2-1B, MobileLLM-Pro, OpenFlamingo-3B, and Qwen3.5-2B, as well as end-to-end Raspberry Pi~5 deployment demonstrate that CoRA supports effective task-conditioned retrieval without retriever fine-tuning, backpropagation, or target-model calls.

AI.title_translation: 端侧上下文学习的无梯度任务条件检索
AI.tldr: CoRA是一个无需梯度训练和反向传播的框架，通过闭形式岭回归与低秩分解实现高效的端侧任务条件示范检索。
AI.motivation: 端侧上下文学习（ICL）需要在计算、内存和数据隐私预算极为有限的条件下，利用任务特定信息从本地存储中检索高质量的示范样本。
AI.method: 提出Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA)无梯度框架：1. 利用冻结编码器的互补层提取特征；2. 从候选存储的输出中构建条件空间，通过闭形式岭回归将候选输入表示对齐到该空间；3. 采用低秩因子分解生成紧凑检索基，并推导出两阶段流式构建算法以节省内存；4. 扩展至多模态示范检索。
AI.result: 在10个文本数据集和4个多模态基准（使用Llama-3.2-1B、MobileLLM-Pro、OpenFlamingo-3B、Qwen3.5-2B）以及树莓派5（Raspberry Pi 5）的真实部署实验中，CoRA在无需微调、反向传播或目标模型调用的情况下实现了高效且准确的任务条件检索。
AI.conclusion: CoRA为资源受限的端侧设备提供了一种高效、无梯度且数学严谨的任务条件检索方案，无需微调或反向传播即可显著提升端侧上下文学习的检索性能。
AI.translation: 端侧上下文学习（ICL）依赖推理前的检索，以在下游模型推理前选择有用的上下文示范。这种检索必须在有限的计算、内存和数据暴露预算下利用任务特定信息。我们提出了条件检索对齐（CoRA），这是一个无梯度的框架，利用成对的候选输入和输出将冻结的编码器转换为任务条件检索器。CoRA选择互补的编码器层，从候选存储中构建由输出派生的条件空间，并通过闭形式岭回归将候选输入表示对齐到该空间。低秩因子分解随后产生一个紧凑的检索基，其中候选输出仅在离线索引构建期间使用，而查询时的检索仅需要查询输入和预计算的索引。我们证明了CoRA的秩受限基是输出条件拟合表示的最优低秩压缩，并推导出了一个精确的两阶段流式构建方法，避免了实例化完整的拟合矩阵。我们通过将视觉表示融入条件和检索空间，进一步将该框架扩展到多模态样本检索。在十个文本数据集和四个多模态基准上的实验（采用Llama-3.2-1B、MobileLLM-Pro、OpenFlamingo-3B和Qwen3.5-2B），以及树莓派5（Raspberry Pi 5）上的端到端部署表明，CoRA无需检索器微调、反向传播或目标模型调用，即可支持有效的任务条件检索。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于端侧上下文学习的无梯度任务条件检索框架CoRA。该方法通过闭形式岭回归与低秩分解，将冻结编码器的输入表示对齐到由候选输出构建的条件空间，并在离线阶段利用流式算法生成紧凑索引。实验及端侧硬件部署表明，CoRA在无反向传播和微调的前提下实现了优异的检索效果与极低的算力消耗。
AI.keywords: 上下文学习, 示范检索, 无梯度对齐, 端侧计算, 多模态检索
AI.comments: 创新性：提出无梯度的闭形式对齐与流式低秩分解框架（CoRA），无需反向传播或复杂的检索器微调即可实现任务条件检索；重要性：显著降低了端侧设备在上下文学习中的计算与内存开销，并在树莓派5等边缘设备上完成了部署验证，具有极强的实用价值；局限性：离线索引构建阶段仍需依赖候选输出信息，对于超大规模或频繁动态变动的存储库，索引更新成本可能需要进一步评估。

title: Train Small, Deploy Large: Zero-Shot GNN Transfer Through Geometric Renormalization
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can operate on large graphs but become infrastructure-sensitive at the scale of millions of nodes and typically require scalable training techniques for even larger graphs. This raises a central question: when can a model trained on a smaller, scaled-down replica of a graph be deployed on the full-resolution graph without retraining? We introduce a zero-shot transfer protocol in which a GNN is trained on a graph coarse-grained by geometric renormalization (GR), and the resulting weights are transferred directly to the original network. Across synthetic and real-world networks, training on GR scaled-down replicas preserves much of the original-scale predictive performance while significantly reducing training cost. We further find that learned representations and predictive trajectories remain aligned across scales. These findings suggest that structural similarity may be more important than network size in determining GNN transferability, opening a path toward scale-equivariant graph architectures.

AI.title_translation: 小图训练，大图部署：基于几何重正则化的零样本GNN迁移
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于几何重正则化的零样本迁移协议，允许在缩小后的子图上训练GNN并直接部署到大规模原图，大幅降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）在处理数百万节点规模的大图时对基础设施要求高且训练成本昂贵，论文旨在探索能否在大幅缩小的图副本上训练GNN，并无需重新训练即可直接部署到全分辨率原图上。
AI.method: 提出了一种零样本迁移协议：首先利用几何重正则化（GR）对原始大图进行粗粒化处理生成等效的缩小副本；在该小图副本上训练GNN模型；最后将训练好的模型权重直接迁移部署到原始大图上。
AI.result: 在合成网络和真实网络上的实验表明，在GR粗粒化副本上训练能在大幅降低训练成本的同时，保留原始尺度上的绝大部分预测性能，且模型在不同尺度间的表征和预测轨迹保持对齐。
AI.conclusion: 结构相似性可能比网络规模在决定GNN可迁移性方面起着更关键的作用，这为开发具有尺度等变性的图神经网络架构奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 图神经网络（GNN）虽然能够处理大型图，但在数百万节点规模下对基础设施非常敏感，对于更大的图通常需要可扩展的训练技术。这就引发了一个核心问题：在较小的缩小图副本上训练的模型，何时可以不经过重新训练就直接部署到全分辨率的原始图上？我们提出了一种零样本迁移协议，其中GNN在通过几何重正则化（GR）粗粒化的图上进行训练，并将获得的权重直接迁移到原始网络。在合成网络和真实网络上的实验表明，在GR缩小的副本上训练大幅降低了训练成本，同时保留了原始尺度上的大部分预测性能。我们进一步发现，学习到的表征和预测轨迹在不同尺度间保持对齐。这些发现表明，在决定GNN可迁移性方面，结构相似性可能比网络规模更重要，从而为走向尺度等变的图架构开辟了一条途径。
AI.summary: 针对大规模图神经网络训练成本高昂的问题，本文提出了基于几何重正则化的零样本GNN迁移方法。该方法通过几何重正则化将大图粗粒化为保留结构特征的小图，在其上训练GNN后直接迁移至原图部署。实验表明，该方案不仅极大地降低了训练资源消耗，还能保持较高的预测准确率与跨尺度表征一致性。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 几何重正则化, 零样本迁移, 尺度等变性
AI.comments:
创新性：将复杂网络/物理学中的几何重正则化（Geometric Renormalization）概念成功引入GNN，提出了“小图训练、大图部署”的零样本迁移范式。
重要性：显著降低了数百万及以上节点规模的超大图训练成本，为构建“尺度等变（scale-equivariant）”图架构开辟了新方向。
局限性：几何重正则化本身构建缩减图的计算复杂度及对高度异质图的普适性在摘要中未详细说明。

title: VocalRender: Score-Native Singing Voice Synthesis for Real-World Composition
summary: Existing singing voice synthesis systems often require predefined durations, explicit duration prediction, or time-aligned acoustic guidance, which limits their compatibility with practical composition workflows. We propose VocalRender, a score-native system that directly synthesizes singing from lyrics, pitches, symbolic note values, and tempo. It uses an interleaved lyric--note representation and an autoregressive diffusion model to generate continuous acoustic latents while predicting the output length, eliminating the need for explicit duration prediction. Trained on a 2,300-hour singing dataset, VocalRender achieves strong intelligibility, strong melody control, and high speaker similarity across both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms the strongest baseline by $0.42$ points in naturalness CMOS, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed score-native architecture.

AI.title_translation: VocalRender：面向现实乐曲创作的原生乐谱歌声合成
AI.tldr: VocalRender 提出了无需显式时长预测的原生乐谱歌声合成框架，通过自回归扩散模型直接从乐谱信息生成高质量歌声。
AI.motivation: 现有的歌唱语音合成（SVS）系统通常需要预定义时长、显式时长预测或时间对齐的声学指导，这限制了它们与实际音乐创作和编曲工作流的兼容性。
AI.method: 提出了 VocalRender 系统，直接从歌词、音高、符号化音符值和曲速生成歌声。系统采用交错的歌词-音符表征（interleaved lyric-note representation）以及自回归扩散模型（autoregressive diffusion model），在预测输出总长度的同时生成连续的声学隐变量，从而消除了对显式时长预测的需求。模型在 2,300 小时的歌唱数据集上进行了训练。
AI.result: VocalRender 在域内和域外基准测试中均展现出出色的可懂度、旋律控制力以及高说话人相似度。在自然度相对主观评分（CMOS）上，VocalRender 比最强的基线模型高出 0.42 分。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果充分验证了所提出的原生乐谱架构的有效性，为现实创作场景提供了一种更加灵活、高效且高质量的歌唱语音合成解决方案。
AI.translation: 现有的歌唱语音合成系统通常需要预定义时长、显式时长预测或时间对齐的声学指导，这限制了它们与实际编曲工作流的兼容性。我们提出了 VocalRender，一个直接从歌词、音高、符号音符值和曲速合成歌声的原生乐谱系统。它采用交错的歌词-音符表征和自回归扩散模型，在预测输出长度的同时生成连续的声学隐变量，从而消除了显式时长预测的需求。在 2,300 小时的歌唱数据集上训练后，VocalRender 在域内和域外基准测试中均实现了很强的可懂度、出色的旋律控制力以及高说话人相似度。值得注意的是，它在自然度 CMOS 上超越最强基线模型 0.42 分，证明了我们提出的原生乐谱架构的有效性。
AI.summary: VocalRender 是一种面向现实乐曲创作的原生乐谱歌声合成系统。它无需显式的时长预测或预先时间对齐，直接以歌词、音高、符号音符和曲速作为输入，利用交错歌词-音符表征与自回归扩散模型生成连续声学隐变量并预测输出长度。在 2300 小时歌声数据上训练的 VocalRender 在自然度、旋律控制和歌手相似度上均取得优异表现。
AI.keywords: 歌声合成, 原生乐谱, 自回归扩散模型, 音乐创作, 时长预测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种“原生乐谱”（score-native）的歌声合成架构，摒弃了传统 SVS 模型对预定义时长、显式时长预测或强制时间对齐信息的依赖，极大简化了歌唱语音合成与实际 MIDI 编曲工作流的对接过程。通过结合交错的歌词-音符表征与自回归扩散模型，不仅实现了自然流畅的歌声生成，还在 CMOS 指标上展现出显著优势，对现实音乐制作具有重要应用价值。

title: Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold
summary: A single reinforcement-learning run can produce a strong reasoner yet an incomplete teacher: it often amplifies only a subset of the valid solution modes. We argue that reinforcement learning (RL)-trained policies should therefore be viewed as local probes of a multi-basin reasoning solution manifold, rather than as globally reliable supervisors. Based on this view, we propose an expand-then-compress framework that couples teacher construction with multi-teacher policy distillation. In the expansion stage, Residual Group Relative Policy Optimization (RGRPO) trains a sequence of teachers from a common initialization and redirects each later round toward examples not yet covered by the accumulated teacher union. In the compression stage, reliability-gated Teacher-Union On-policy Distillation (TU-OPD) lets the student learn from its own response prefixes. For each example, only reliable teachers contribute, and their sampled-token OPD losses are weighted by their per-example quality. We further introduce Consensus-Residual Decomposition, which preserves a winner teacher's excess token preferences over its reliable peers, preventing specialist behavior from being suppressed during teacher aggregation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following show that the resulting Qwen3-1.7B student consistently outperforms the strongest individual teacher across all three domains, yielding relative improvements of 2.0%, 8.3%, and 6.9%, respectively, while retaining single-model inference. These results establish a simple but powerful principle: stronger students can be obtained not by selecting a single better teacher, but by deliberately constructing and compressing a complementary teacher union.

AI.title_translation: 超越最佳教师：拓展与压缩推理解流形
AI.tldr: 提出“先扩展后压缩”的多教师蒸馏框架，通过构建互补的教师联合体并进行知识压缩，使单模型学生在数学、代码和指令遵循任务上全面超越最强单个教师。
AI.motivation: 单次强化学习（RL）训练的策略往往只能放大有效解模式的一个子集，充其量是多盆地推理解流形的局部探测器，而非全局可靠的监督者。传统依赖单一“最佳教师”的做法无法充分覆盖复杂的推理空间。
AI.method: 提出“先扩展后压缩”框架：1）扩展阶段：采用残差组相对策略优化（RGRPO）从相同初始化训练多轮教师，并将后续训练定向引导至未覆盖的难题；2）压缩阶段：利用可靠性门控的教师联合体在线策略蒸馏（TU-OPD），让学生从自身响应前缀中学习，仅保留可靠教师的加权损失；3）机制优化：引入共识-残差分解（Consensus-Residual Decomposition），保留胜者教师的超额 Token 偏好，防止专家行为在聚合时被抵消。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循三大任务上的实验表明，最终得到的 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型全面且持续地超越了最强单个教师，相对性能分别提升了 2.0%、8.3% 和 6.9%，同时保持了单模型推理的低成本优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，获取更强学生模型的核心不在于寻找单个更好的教师，而在于有意识地构建并压缩互补的教师联合体。
AI.translation: 单次强化学习运行可以产生强有力的推理器，但往往是一个不完备的教师：它通常只放大有效解模式的一个子集。因此，我们主张将通过强化学习（RL）训练的策略视为多盆地推理解流形的局部探测器，而非全局可靠的监督者。基于这一观点，我们提出了一个“先扩展后压缩”的框架，将教师构建与多教师策略蒸馏相结合。在扩展阶段，残差组相对策略优化（RGRPO）从共同初始化训练一系列教师，并将后续每一轮转向尚未被累积教师联合体覆盖的样本。在压缩阶段，具有可靠性门控的教师联合体在线策略蒸馏（TU-OPD）让学生从自身响应前缀中学习。对于每个样本，仅由可靠的教师贡献，且其采样Token的OPD损失按其单样本质量加权。我们进一步引入了共识-残差分解（Consensus-Residual Decomposition），该方法保留了胜者教师相对于其可靠同伴的超额Token偏好，防止专家行为在教师聚合过程中被抑制。在数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循方面的实验表明，最终得到的 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型在所有三个领域均持续优于最强的单个教师，相对提升分别为 2.0%、8.3% 和 6.9%，同时保留了单模型推理的优势。这些结果建立了一个简单而强大的原则：通过有意识地构建和压缩互补的教师联合体，而不是选择单个更好的教师，可以获得更强大的学生模型。
AI.summary: 针对强化学习策略仅能覆盖部分解空间的局限性，本文提出了“先扩展后压缩”的多教师蒸馏框架。该框架首先通过残差组相对策略优化（RGRPO）训练一系列互补的教师模型，随后通过带有可靠性门控和共识-残差分解的在线策略蒸馏（TU-OPD）将教师联合体的知识压缩至单一学生模型中。实验证明，该方法培养出的学生模型在多个领域均显著优于任何单个教师模型。
AI.keywords: 强化学习 (Reinforcement Learning), 知识蒸馏 (Knowledge Distillation), 多教师融合 (Multi-Teacher Fusion), 推理解流形 (Reasoning Solution Manifold), 策略优化 (Policy Optimization)
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将RL训练策略视为推理解流形的局部探测器，打破了传统蒸馏中寻找单一“最佳教师”的瓶颈。通过“扩展-压缩”两阶段框架以及共识-残差分解机制，成功实现了多教师互补知识的有效融合，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著超越了单个强教师模型的性能，具有很强的理论见解与实用价值。

title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session interaction and personalization. However, existing agent memory systems are designed around forward-only evolution, continuously accumulating, consolidating, and overwriting knowledge, with no principled mechanism to inspect, version, or revert prior states. This makes agents brittle under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption, particularly after they have already been exposed to subsequent information. We present ChronoMem, a semantic version-control layer for agentic memory integrated into the production-ready, open-source Agent Development Kit by Google. ChronoMem commits whole-memory snapshots at each memory write, maintains structured version histories, and supports natural-language rollback requests by mapping undo intents to concrete historical versions through hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking. We further introduce a post-exposure evaluation protocol that tests whether an agent can behave counterfactually after rollback by answering queries and summarizing history as if future updates had never occurred. On long-horizon conversational benchmarks augmented with evolving memory states and rollback tasks, ChronoMem substantially improves rollback-consistent question answering and history summarization relative to prompt-only and retrieval-only baselines, while achieving strong performance in semantic version selection. To our knowledge, ChronoMem is the first open-source system and benchmark for systematic semantic global memory rollback in LLM agents.

AI.title_translation: ChronoMem：大语言模型智能体记忆的版本控制与语义回滚
AI.tldr: ChronoMem 为 LLM 智能体记忆引入了基于自然语言的语义版本控制与全局回滚机制，解决了智能体记忆无法撤销和修正历史错误的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 智能体记忆系统多为单向演化设计（仅不断累积、巩固和覆盖知识），缺乏检查、版本控制或恢复历史状态的规范机制。这使得智能体在面对信息纠正、概念漂移或记忆损坏（尤其是已接触后续干扰信息后）时非常脆弱。
AI.method: 提出 ChronoMem 语义版本控制层（集成于谷歌 Agent Development Kit）：在每次记忆写入时提交全量记忆快照并维护结构化版本历史；通过词汇与语义混合检索、排序融合（rank fusion）及重排序（reranking），将自然语言撤销意图准确映射至历史版本；同时设计了暴露后评估协议（post-exposure evaluation protocol），检验回滚后智能体能否像未接触过后续信息一样进行反事实问答与历史总结。
AI.result: 在长时域对话基准测试中，ChronoMem 在回滚一致性问答和历史总结任务上的表现显著优于仅提示（prompt-only）和仅检索（retrieval-only）基线，并在语义版本选择上取得了优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: ChronoMem 是首个实现大语言模型智能体系统性全局语义记忆回滚的开源系统与评估基准。
AI.translation: LLM 智能体日益依赖长期记忆来支持多会话交互和个性化体验。然而，现有的智能体记忆系统围绕单向演化设计，不断累积、巩固和覆盖知识，缺乏检查、版本控制或还原先前状态的规范机制。这使得智能体在面对纠正、概念漂移和记忆损坏时非常脆弱，特别是在它们已经接触了后续信息之后。我们提出了 ChronoMem，这是一个用于智能体记忆的语义版本控制层，已集成到谷歌生产级开源智能体开发工具包（Agent Development Kit）中。ChronoMem 在每次记忆写入时提交全量记忆快照，维护结构化的版本历史记录，并通过混合词汇与语义检索、排序融合和重排序，将撤销意图映射到具体的历史版本，从而支持自然语言回滚请求。我们进一步引入了一种暴露后评估协议，测试智能体在回滚后能否像未来更新未发生过一样回答查询并总结历史，即进行反事实行为评估。在增加了演化记忆状态和回滚任务的长时域对话基准测试中，相对于仅提示和仅检索的基线，ChronoMem 显著提高了回滚一致性问答和历史总结的性能，同时在语义版本选择方面取得了强劲表现。据我们所知，ChronoMem 是首个用于 LLM 智能体系统性语义全局记忆回滚的开源系统和基准测试。
AI.summary: 针对大模型智能体记忆缺乏版本控制与状态还原能力的问题，本文提出了 ChronoMem 系统。该系统在记忆写入时记录快照，并通过混合检索与重排序技术将自然语言撤销请求精准映射至历史版本，实现了全局语义记忆回滚，同时提出了配套的反事实评估基准。
AI.keywords: 智能体记忆, 版本控制, 语义回滚, 大语言模型, 反事实评估
AI.comments: 创新性：将软件工程中的“版本控制”与“代码回滚”思想首次系统性引入大模型智能体长期记忆管理，填补了记忆纠错与撤销机制的空白；实用性：直接集成于谷歌开源的 Agent Development Kit，并提出了暴露后（post-exposure）反事实评估协议；局限性：每次记忆写入均保存全量快照可能会带来较大的存储开销，在长时序、高频更新场景下的伸缩性与效率仍需关注。

title: RIPPLE: Generating Multi-Channel Phase, Not Recovering It
summary: Generative models synthesize magnitude spectra with high fidelity, while phase is delegated to a recovery module---Griffin--Lim, a vocoder, or a latent decoder---applied independently to each channel. For multi-channel waveforms this delegation is costly: the physical content of spatial audio and three-component seismograms lives in the phase relationships between channels, precisely what channel-independent recovery cannot produce. The cost is also invisible, since the magnitude-based metrics common to both fields barely move when inter-channel phase coherence collapses---so a pipeline can discard the physical information in its output while still scoring well. We argue that phase should be generated, not recovered, and present RIPPLE (Rectified Inter-channel Phase with Prior-based LEarning), which reinterprets Griffin--Lim as a phase **prior** rather than a final estimator: initialized from the source phase, this prior carries the inter-channel structure to be preserved, and a rectified flow refines it toward the target under an explicit inter-channel phase loss. Tested on first-order ambisonics environment transfer and seismic cross-station translation---two physically unrelated domains---RIPPLE outperforms recovery-based pipelines on the coherence metrics that downstream analyses consume.
