AI.keywords: 多模态RAG, 图神经网络, 宏观推理, 微观匹配, 多跳推理
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的双层图框架，巧妙地解决了多模态RAG中细粒度与粗粒度表示之间的权衡问题。宏观推理与微观匹配的解耦设计，以及通过动态规划解码机制提取显式推理路径，是重要的贡献。这不仅提升了复杂多跳推理能力，还为生成模型提供了更具解释性和连贯性的结构化指导，具有较高的创新性和实用价值。

title: ROAD: Reciprocal-Objective Alignment of Discriminative Semantics for 3D Shape Generation
summary: High-fidelity 3D generation predominantly relies on scaling model capacity and data, which incurs prohibitive computational costs. This paradigm typically requires learning geometry from scratch and overlooks the rich semantic and structural priors already encapsulated in discriminative 3D foundation models. We contend that leveraging the profound understanding of the 3D world possessed by these discriminative models can significantly reduce generative cost. To this end, we propose ROAD, a framework that reduces the training cost of 3D generation by transferring these rich discriminative priors into diffusion transformers. To address the inherent semantic-structural heterogeneity between generative and discriminative latents, we introduce a reciprocal-objective alignment strategy. This method synergizes Holistic Semantic Condensing to enforce global semantic coherence and Structural Optimal Alignment, which is formulated as a bipartite matching problem to rigorously align microscopic geometric details between disparate latent spaces. The 3D foundation model is only used for training-time supervision of alignment and is not used at inference, incurring no additional inference cost. Compared with the industrial baseline Step1X-3D, the proposed ROAD achieves highly competitive generation performance with only 1.5% of the training data and significantly reduces training costs, effectively reducing the computational overhead of high-fidelity 3D generation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/ROAD.

AI.title_translation: ROAD：判别语义的互惠目标对齐用于三维形状生成
AI.tldr: ROAD通过将判别式3D基础模型的语义先验知识转移到扩散 transformer 中，显著降低了高保真3D形状生成的训练成本，实现了与现有方法相当的性能，但仅使用了极少的数据。
AI.motivation: 高保真3D生成模型依赖于大规模的模型和数据，导致计算成本过高，并且忽略了判别式3D基础模型中已有的丰富语义和结构先验知识。
AI.method: 本文提出了ROAD框架，旨在通过将判别式3D基础模型的丰富先验知识转移到扩散 transformer 中来降低3D生成的训练成本。为解决生成式和判别式潜在空间之间固有的语义-结构异质性，ROAD引入了一种互惠目标对齐策略。该策略包含整体语义凝聚（Holistic Semantic Condensing）以强制全局语义一致性，以及结构最优对齐（Structural Optimal Alignment），后者被表述为一个二分匹配问题以严格对齐微观几何细节。判别式3D基础模型仅用于训练时的对齐监督，推理时无需使用，不产生额外推理成本。
AI.result: 与工业基线Step1X-3D相比，ROAD在仅使用1.5%的训练数据的情况下，实现了极具竞争力的生成性能，并显著降低了训练成本，有效减少了高保真3D生成的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: ROAD通过有效利用判别式3D基础模型的先验知识，提供了一种高效率且低成本的高保真3D形状生成方法，克服了传统方法对大规模数据和计算资源的依赖。
AI.translation: 高保真3D生成主要依赖于扩展模型容量和数据，这会带来高昂的计算成本。这种范式通常需要从头开始学习几何，并忽视了判别式3D基础模型中已封装的丰富语义和结构先验知识。我们认为，利用这些判别式模型对3D世界的深刻理解可以显著降低生成成本。为此，我们提出了ROAD，一个通过将这些丰富的判别式先验知识转移到扩散 transformer 中来降低3D生成训练成本的框架。为了解决生成式和判别式潜在空间之间固有的语义-结构异质性，我们引入了一种互惠目标对齐策略。该方法通过整体语义凝聚（Holistic Semantic Condensing）来强制执行全局语义一致性，并通过结构最优对齐（Structural Optimal Alignment）来协同作用，后者被表述为一个二分匹配问题，以严格对齐不同潜在空间之间的微观几何细节。3D基础模型仅用于训练时的对齐监督，在推理时无需使用，因此不会产生额外的推理成本。与工业基线Step1X-3D相比，所提出的ROAD在仅使用1.5%的训练数据的情况下，实现了极具竞争力的生成性能，并显著降低了训练成本，有效减少了高保真3D生成的计算开销。代码可在https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/ROAD获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ROAD框架，旨在通过将判别式3D基础模型中的丰富语义和结构先验知识转移到扩散 transformer 中，以显著降低高保真3D形状生成的训练成本。为解决生成式和判别式潜在空间间的异质性，ROAD引入互惠目标对齐策略，包含整体语义凝聚和结构最优对齐（通过二分匹配实现）。实验表明，ROAD仅用1.5%的训练数据即可达到与现有方法相当的生成性能，并大幅降低训练开销。
AI.keywords: 3D形状生成, 扩散模型, 判别式先验, 语义对齐, 计算成本降低
AI.comments: ROAD的创新之处在于其有效地利用了预训练判别式3D模型的强大能力，将其先验知识迁移到生成任务中，从而极大地减少了对大规模训练数据和计算资源的需求。这种范式转移为高保真3D内容的创建提供了一条更经济高效的途径，对于资源受限的研究者和行业应用具有重要意义。互惠目标对齐策略是其核心贡献，巧妙地解决了不同模型间潜在空间的语义与结构对齐挑战。

title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $β$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $β$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.

AI.title_translation: β-OPSD：通过策略优化推导，通过自蒸馏训练
AI.tldr: β-OPSD改进了现有的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法，通过引入一个可控的正则化参数β，将策略优化与自蒸馏相结合，解决了传统OPSD的稳定性问题，并在数学推理任务上取得了更好的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法在实践中不稳定，需要大量的工程努力才能使其可靠工作。本文旨在解决这一困难，并提供一个更通用、更稳定的框架。
AI.method: 本文将香草OPSD识别为一个更广泛的策略优化家族中β=1的成员，并引入了β-OPSD。它将β从一个固定值变为一个可控的正则化参数，并将其最优策略推导为参考策略和特权教师之间的几何插值。为了避免昂贵的强化学习优化，本文将闭式解转化为一个蒸馏目标，通过混合令牌级logits来高效实现，从而用廉价的蒸馏近似昂贵的策略优化。此外，还通过return-to-go信用分配来对齐令牌更新。
AI.result: β-OPSD在数学推理基准测试中始终优于香草OPSD，提高了优化稳定性和下游推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一条从自蒸馏到策略优化再返回的原则性路径，且不牺牲OPSD的效率。通过将β作为一个可控的正则化参数，β-OPSD在保持效率的同时，提升了策略优化的稳定性和性能。
AI.translation: 在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）是一种改进推理语言模型的有前景方法，但它在实践中仍然脆弱：使其可靠工作通常需要大量的工程努力。我们发现了这种困难的结构性来源：香草OPSD恰好是更广泛的策略优化家族中β=1的成员，其中β权重KL惩罚，将学生锚定到参考策略。这种等价性将β从一个固定为一的隐式值变成了可控的正则化参数，产生了一个更通用的公式，权衡了与参考策略的接近程度和特权教师指导。我们引入了β-OPSD，并将其最优策略推导为参考策略和特权教师之间的几何插值。然而，直接用强化学习优化这个目标将是昂贵且方差高的。我们没有直接优化RL目标，而是将其闭式解转化为一个蒸馏目标。β的每个值都沿着从参考到教师的路径选择一个目标，我们通过混合它们的令牌级logits来高效实现。通过这种方式，廉价的蒸馏近似了昂贵的策略优化的解决方案。Return-to-go信用分配进一步将令牌更新与序列级目标对齐，同时保留了OPSD的简洁性。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，β-OPSD始终优于香草OPSD，提高了优化稳定性和下游推理性能。我们的结果提供了一条从自蒸馏到策略优化再返回的原则性路径，且不牺牲OPSD的效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了β-OPSD，它将传统的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）泛化为一个更广泛的策略优化家族，其中β作为一个可控的正则化参数。通过将β-OPSD的最优策略推导为参考策略和特权教师之间的几何插值，并利用高效的自蒸馏方法（通过混合令牌级logits）来近似昂贵的策略优化，解决了现有OPSD的稳定性问题。实验证明，β-OPSD在数学推理任务上显著优于香草OPSD，提升了优化稳定性和推理性能，为自蒸馏和策略优化提供了一个高效且原则性的连接。
AI.keywords: 策略优化,自蒸馏,β-OPSD,语言模型,数学推理
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将自蒸馏与策略优化在理论上进行了统一，并通过引入可控参数β解决了现有OPSD的实践难题。它将β从一个固定的隐式值转变为一个可调节的超参数，从而在理论上更具普遍性，并在实践中提供了更强的鲁棒性。通过将RL问题转化为蒸馏目标，巧妙地解决了计算效率问题，使其在实际应用中更具可行性。

title: CrossAtlas: Evaluating Projection Techniques for Spatial Referencing in Cross-Reality Collaboration
comments: 11 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to IEEE ISMAR 2026 (TVCG journal track)
summary: Cross-reality collaboration increasingly connects immersive and desktop users within synchronized workspaces, yet little is known about how bidirectional projection techniques between immersive 3D layouts and desktop 2D views influence communication. Spatial referencing depends on shared spatial understanding, but different mappings preserve and distort geometric relationships in different ways, altering perceived adjacency, orientation, and coverage across collaborators' views. We present CrossAtlas, a synchronized PC-VR collaboration platform that integrates multiple bidirectional projection techniques, including three planar projection variants and equirectangular, a spherical projection variant, across layouts of varying curvature. In a controlled study with 24 dyads, collaborators completed spatial referencing tasks under different projection-layout conditions while we collected performance and subjective measures. Our results show that projection choice strongly shaped collaboration, with the spherical variant often outperforming planar projections and remaining robust across object layouts.
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to IEEE ISMAR 2026 (TVCG journal track)

AI.title_translation: CrossAtlas：评估跨现实协作中空间参考的投影技术
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了在跨现实协作中，沉浸式3D布局和桌面2D视图之间的双向投影技术如何影响空间参考通信。结果显示，球形投影变体通常优于平面投影。
AI.motivation: 跨现实协作日益将沉浸式用户和桌面用户连接到同步工作空间，但关于沉浸式3D布局和桌面2D视图之间的双向投影技术如何影响通信，人们知之甚少。空间参考依赖于共享的空间理解，但不同的映射以不同的方式保留和扭曲几何关系，改变了协作参与者视图中的感知邻近性、方向和覆盖范围。因此，需要评估不同的投影技术对空间参考的影响。
AI.method: 研究团队提出了CrossAtlas，一个同步的PC-VR协作平台，它集成了多种双向投影技术，包括三种平面投影变体和一种球形投影变体（等距圆柱投影），用于不同曲率的布局。在一个有24对参与者的对照研究中，协作参与者在不同的投影-布局条件下完成了空间参考任务，同时收集了性能和主观测量数据。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，投影选择强烈影响了协作，其中球形投影变体通常优于平面投影，并且在不同对象布局中保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 球形投影技术在跨现实协作的空间参考任务中表现出比平面投影更好的性能和鲁棒性，是跨现实协作中空间参考的有效选择。
AI.translation: 跨现实协作日益将沉浸式用户和桌面用户连接到同步工作空间，但关于沉浸式3D布局和桌面2D视图之间的双向投影技术如何影响通信，人们知之甚少。空间参考依赖于共享的空间理解，但不同的映射以不同的方式保留和扭曲几何关系，改变了协作参与者视图中的感知邻近性、方向和覆盖范围。我们提出了CrossAtlas，一个同步的PC-VR协作平台，它集成了多种双向投影技术，包括三种平面投影变体和一种球形投影变体（等距圆柱投影），用于不同曲率的布局。在一个有24对参与者的对照研究中，协作参与者在不同的投影-布局条件下完成了空间参考任务，同时收集了性能和主观测量数据。我们的结果表明，投影选择强烈影响了协作，其中球形投影变体通常优于平面投影，并且在不同对象布局中保持稳健。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了CrossAtlas平台，用于评估跨现实协作中沉浸式3D和桌面2D视图之间的双向投影技术对空间参考通信的影响。通过对24对参与者的对照研究，比较了多种平面和球形投影变体在不同布局下的表现。结果表明，投影选择对协作有显著影响，其中球形投影变体通常优于平面投影，并对不同对象布局表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 跨现实协作, 空间参考, 投影技术, CrossAtlas, PC-VR
AI.comments: 本文通过提出CrossAtlas平台并进行对照实验，系统地评估了不同投影技术在跨现实协作中对空间参考的影响，填补了该领域研究的空白。其创新之处在于集成多种双向投影技术并进行实证比较，为未来的跨现实系统设计提供了重要的实践指导。特别是指出了球形投影的优越性，对优化跨现实协作用户体验具有重要意义。

title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
comments: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue by extracting issue references from the PR description; the issue description is used as the problem statement, and the PR patch serves as the test oracle. However, due to the inherent complexity of developing and maintaining large repositories, such PR-Issue pairings are often misaligned in practice. In this work, we systematically study SWE-bench Verified instances, finding that 13.6% exhibit misalignment across five patterns in eleven fine-grained scenarios. To enable reliable and scalable construction of those benchmarks in the future, we propose PAIChecker, a multi-agent system for checking PR-Issue misalignment in SWE-bench-like benchmarks. Specifically, PAIChecker adopts a three-phase design that combines specific pattern identification, cross-agent label synthesis, and code-level validation, thereby enabling more accurate, generalizable, and progressively verified detection. Experiments on SWE-Gym and SWE-bench Multilingual show that PAIchecker achieves the best performance across all four LLM backbones, reaching up to 92.12% and 91.67% binary accuracy, respectively.
comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)

AI.title_translation: PAIChecker：揭示与检查类SWE-bench基准测试中的PR-Issue错位问题
AI.tldr: 本文针对SWE-bench类基准测试中13.6%的PR-Issue错位问题，提出了一种高效的多智能体检测系统PAIChecker，显著提升了基准测试的可靠性。
AI.motivation: SWE-bench类基准测试中PR与链接的Issue由于开发复杂性经常存在错位问题，这会影响大模型评估的准确性，因此需要一种系统化的方法来检测和解决这种错位。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PAIChecker的多智能体系统，包含三个阶段：特定模式识别、跨智能体标签综合以及代码级验证。
AI.result: 对SWE-bench Verified的系统研究发现13.6%的实例存在错位（涵盖5种模式和11种细粒度场景）；在SWE-Gym和SWE-bench Multilingual上的实验表明，PAIChecker在四种LLM骨干网上均实现了最佳性能，二分类准确率分别高达92.12%和91.67%。
AI.conclusion: PAIChecker通过多智能体系统有效解决了SWE-bench类基准测试中的PR-Issue错位问题，在多个数据集和不同大模型基底上均取得了优异的检测准确率。
AI.translation: 类似SWE-bench的基准测试被广泛用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的问题解决能力。它们通常遵循共同的构建管道：每个Pull Request（PR）通过从PR描述中提取问题引用与其链接的Issue进行配对；Issue描述用作问题陈述，PR补丁充当测试预言机。然而，由于开发和维护大型代码库的固有复杂性，此类PR-Issue配对在实践中经常出现错位。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了SWE-bench Verified实例，发现13.6%的实例在11个细粒度场景的5种模式下表现出错位。为了在未来实现可靠且可扩展的此类基准构建，我们提出了PAIChecker，一个用于检查类SWE-bench基准中PR-Issue错位的多智能体系统。具体而言，PAIChecker采用了三阶段设计，结合了特定模式识别、跨智能体标签综合和代码级验证，从而实现了更准确、可泛化和逐步验证的检测。在SWE-Gym和SWE-bench Multilingual上的实验表明，PAIChecker在所有四个LLM骨干网上均取得了最佳性能，二分类准确率分别高达92.12%和91.67%。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了SWE-bench类基准测试中常见的PR与Issue错位问题，发现13.6%的实例存在错位。为此，作者开发了PAIChecker——一个采用三阶段设计的多智能体系统，用于准确、可扩展地检测PR-Issue错位，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: PR-Issue错位, SWE-bench, 多智能体系统, 代码大语言模型评估, 自动检测
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地研究了SWE-bench类型基准测试中PR与Issue错位的问题，揭示了高达13.6%的错位率，并提出了一种基于多智能体系统的自动化检测工具PAIChecker，对提升大语言模型代码修复能力的评估准确性具有重要意义。

title: The Complexity of Kemeny Aggregation with Three Rankings
summary: The Kemeny rule aggregates rankings by minimizing their total Kendall-tau distance from an aggregate order. We prove that Kemeny Score is NP-complete for exactly three unweighted rankings, even when every candidate pair is split $2$-to-$1$. On the same profiles, the winner, unique-winner, and possible- and necessary-precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, while recognizing a Kemeny-optimal or uniquely Kemeny-optimal aggregate is coNP-complete. The hard instances induce tournaments of majority dimension exactly $3$. The reduction also determines the exact maximum-cut value from the optimal Kemeny score and recovers a maximum cut from any Kemeny-optimal aggregate. For every fixed $q\geq3$ and $\lceil q/2\rceil\leq s\leq q$, minimum pairwise support $s$ yields a sharp dichotomy: the score problem is NP-complete, the winner and precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, and the recognition problems are coNP-complete when $3s\leq2q$; for $3s>2q$, the majority tournament is transitive and its unique topological order is the unique Kemeny-optimal aggregate. Exact support $s$ suffices in the hard case when $s>q/2$, and supports in ${s,s+1}$ suffice when $s=q/2$. These results give complete fixed-profile-size classifications and transfer to Slater orders, permutation medians, and maximum-likelihood central rankings in the Mallows model. Finally, a six-copy construction proves NP-completeness of both Kemeny Score and Kendall--Tau Center for three pairwise-equidistant rankings that still split every pair $2$-to-$1$. For $N$ output candidates, their common distance is $\frac23\binom N2$, the largest possible for an equidistant triple. The construction gives affine formulas for both optimal values, characterizes all Kemeny-optimal output orders, and shows that the output has a unique Kemeny-optimal order and a unique center exactly when the input has a unique Kemeny-optimal order.

AI.title_translation: 具有三个排序的Kemeny聚合的复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文证明了仅有三个排序时的Kemeny聚合及相关决策问题具有较高的计算复杂度（如NP完全性、$\Theta_2^p$完全性等），并给出了完整的复杂度分类。
AI.motivation: 尽管Kemeny聚合规则在社交选择和偏好学习中非常重要，但当输入排序数量较少（如三个排序）时的精确计算复杂度及其相关变体的行为尚未完全厘清，作者旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 通过构造特定的输入实例（如每个候选对以2比1分裂的档案以及六副本构造），运用计算复杂性理论中的归约方法，证明了各类相关判定和优化问题的完备性。
AI.result: 证明了当有三个未加权排序时，Kemeny得分问题是NP完全的，相关的赢家和优先问题是$\Theta_2^p$完全的，识别问题是coNP完全的；并为任意固定的$q$给出了清晰的复杂度二分法，且结果可推广至Slater序、置换中位数和Mallows模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全界定了三个排序的Kemeny聚合及相关问题的计算复杂度，确立了清晰的复杂度二分法，并拓展至多个相关模型。
AI.translation: Kemeny规则通过最小化它们与聚合顺序的总Kendall-tau距离来聚合排序。我们证明了对于恰好三个未加权排序，Kemeny得分（Kemeny Score）是NP完全的，即使每个候选对都以2比1分裂。在相同的档案下，赢家、唯一赢家以及可能和必要的优先权问题是$\Theta_2^p$完全的，而识别一个Kemeny最优或唯一的Kemeny最优聚合是coNP完全的。困难实例诱导出了多数维数恰好为3的锦标赛。该归约还确定了从最优Kemeny得分中得到的精确最大割值，并从任何Kemeny最优聚合中恢复出最大割。对于每个固定的$q\geq3$和$\lceil q/2\rceil\leq s\leq q$，最小两两支持度$s$产生了一个鲜明的二分法：当$3s\leq2q$时，得分问题是NP完全的，赢家和优先权问题是$\Theta_2^p$完全的，识别问题是coNP完全的；当$3s>2q$时，多数锦标赛是传递的，其唯一的拓扑阶是唯一的Kemeny最优聚合。当$s>q/2$时，确切的支持度$s$在困难情况下就足够了，而当$s=q/2$时，$\{s,s+1\}$中的支持度就足够了。这些结果给出了完整的固定档案大小分类，并可转化为Slater序、置换中位数以及Mallows模型中的最大似然中心排序。最后，一个六副本构造证明了对于三个两两等距且每个对仍然以2比1分裂的排序，Kemeny得分和Kendall-Tau中心都是NP完全的。对于$N$个输出候选者，它们共同的距离是$\frac{2}{3}\binom{N}{2}$，这是等距三元组可能的最大距离。该构造给出了两个最优值的仿射公式，表征了所有Kemeny最优输出阶数，并表明当且仅当输入具有唯一的Kemeny最优阶数时，输出具有唯一的Kemeny最优阶数和唯一的中心。
AI.summary: 本文研究了三个排序下Kemeny聚合的计算复杂度，证明了即使只有三个排序，Kemeny得分计算也是NP完全的，并给出了针对固定档案大小的完整复杂度分类，同时将其结果推广到了其他几种中心排序模型。
AI.keywords: Kemeny聚合, 计算复杂度, NP完全性, 排序, 多数锦标赛
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了Kemeny排序聚合在三种排序情况下的计算复杂度，首次完整给出了固定档案大小的分类结果，不仅理论性强，而且对相关偏好聚合和统计模型有广泛影响。

title: MixFrag: Fragility-Guided Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as an effective solution for deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTQ methods typically employ uniform bit-widths across transformer components, overlooking their heterogeneous sensitivity to quantization and leading to inefficient precision allocation. In this paper, we propose {MixFrag, a fragility-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework for Vision Transformers. MixFrag first estimates component-level quantization fragility by measuring the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between full-precision and isolated quantized output distributions using a small calibration set. It then formulates bit allocation as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), enabling adaptive layer-wise precision assignment under a target bit budget. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K across multiple Vision Transformer architectures demonstrate that MixFrag achieves competitive classification performance under practical mixed-precision settings. Furthermore, evaluations on COCO object detection and instance segmentation show that MixFrag achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing mixed-precision PTQ methods, improving the previous best method by up to 9.6 AP under the challenging MP3/MP3 setting. Additional analyses validate the proposed fragility metric and demonstrate its strong correlation with the learned bit allocation. These results establish MixFrag as an effective framework for mixed-precision post-training quantization of Vision Transformers.

title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstruction algorithm that estimates the visually attributable part of a teacher correction. At each student-generated prefix, VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with the relevant evidence present and removed. The corresponding change in centered log-probabilities defines ut, a signed proxy for the visual evidence direction that estimates how revealing the evidence supports or refutes candidate tokens. VAD projects the original correction onto this proxy to obtain an intervention-aligned component and a proxy-unexplained residual, then reconstructs a student-anchored target from the former. During training, this reconstructed target supplies the primary supervision signal, while the privileged teacher contributes a weak regularizer. Across six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B scales, VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting. Token- level and controlled-target analyses show that the proxy-aligned component is enriched in task-relevant visual corrections and yields stronger target shifts, especially when evidence refutes a mistaken answer. These results support counterfactual target reconstruction as an effective alternative to source-mixed supervision.

title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures, and 15 tables, including appendices
summary: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs task states through Patch Reversal, Code Mapping, or Agent Reconstruction, and validates the lifecycle from a healthy base to a task state and a restored state. By deriving multiple tasks grounded in developer evidence from maintained environments, Change2Task provides executable data for coding agent training and evaluation while reducing repeated environment setup, storage, and task construction effort. We evaluate the system through five common and widely adopted coding agent task families: Bug Fix, Feature Addition, Test Generation, Application Programming Interface Migration, and Security Repair. Starting from 1,130 source changes eligible for construction, Change2Task achieves 79.6% verified task construction success across these task families. On a matched candidate set, it recovers 29.2% more verified tasks than a construction baseline based on pull requests. Historical and reconstructed cases achieve up to 98.0% matched outcome agreement under agent evaluation, while reuse of modern bases reduces measured expenditure across the complete pipeline by 10.8%.

title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
summary: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm. In this work, we rethink agentic visual reasoning through two key dimensions of tool use: Mode Adaptiveness (MA) and Tool Effect (TE). Mode Adaptiveness characterizes whether an MLLM can recognize when tools are truly necessary and invoke them accordingly, thereby avoiding unnecessary computational overhead while improving performance on challenging problems that require tool assistance. Tool Effect characterizes the actual impact of tool use: tools should extend the model's capabilities on problems unsolvable through text-only reasoning, while avoiding additional errors on problems that the model can already solve without tools. We conduct a comprehensive analysis to quantify these two properties and empirically reveal that existing agentic visual reasoning models exhibit limited Mode Adaptiveness, while the gains produced by tool use on hard examples are largely offset by the harm introduced on easy examples that the models can already solve. Motivated by these observations, we propose Beacon, a novel agentic visual reasoning model that achieves stronger overall performance, improved Mode Adaptiveness, and genuine tool-induced performance gains. At the core of Beacon are the Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and the Hint-Guided Capability Expansion mechanism in the reinforcement learning stage, which respectively encourage adaptive tool invocation based on task necessity and strengthen the model's tool-use capability on the most challenging problems. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate the strong overall performance of Beacon and its substantial improvements in both Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect.

title: FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: In contact-rich manipulation, action multimodality and reactivity dominate different stages of a single episode. Before contact, multiple trajectories might be equally valid, making it important to preserve diverse action modes. After contact, geometric constraints and force limits narrow the solution space, while successful execution demands rapid responses to force feedback. However, standard diffusion policies use a fixed inference frequency and sampling steps throughout the episode, forcing a fundamental compromise: low-frequency, multi-step sampling better preserves pre-contact multimodality but responds slowly to force feedback, whereas high-frequency sampling improves reactivity but tends to collapse distinct pre-contact modes. To resolve this tradeoff, we present FA-RDP, a frequency-adaptive reactive diffusion policy. A shared multi-frequency visual-force Transformer predicts action chunks at both low and high frequencies, while a learned multimodality indicator dynamically selects multi-step low-frequency sampling before contact and one-step high-frequency sampling as action ambiguity decreases. We further introduce Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD), which reparameterizes the diffusion network to predict actions on the robot action manifold while retaining DDPM-based residual supervision. Experiments on three contact-rich manipulation tasks show that FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes. Code and videos are available at https://fa-rdp.github.io.

title: Using Theory of Mind to Arbitrate between Social and Non-social Learning
summary: Social learning is a powerful mechanism through which agents learn about the world from others. However, humans sometimes choose direct experience over social learning, which can carry time and cognitive resource costs. How do people balance social and non-social learning? We propose a Rational Mentalizing model of the decision to engage in social learning. This model estimates the utility of social learning by reasoning about another agent's goal and the informativeness of their future actions. It then weighs the utility of social learning against the utility of non-social learning. Using a novel game where players choose between observing other agents or exploring the environment, we show that the Rational Mentalizing model can quantitatively capture human trade-offs between these strategies. These findings suggest that selective social learning is guided by 'Theory of Mind' in the service of utility maximization.

title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
summary: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We demonstrate that safety fine-tuning suppresses models' tendencies to attribute minds not only to themselves, but also to non-human animals and natural objects, while also driving a reduction in spiritual belief. Both ablating the learned safety-refusal direction and mechanistically steering a consciousness vector in activation space reverse this suppression. Restoring these internal representations recovers broad mind attribution and produces significantly more human-like responses on standardized sociological surveys regarding religiosity, moral values, hope, and subjective well-being. Crucially, these shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind capabilities, demonstrating that core social reasoning remains mechanistically independent. Ultimately, current safety alignment efforts to curb potentially harmful self-attributions of mindedness entangle these self-attributions with benign spiritual beliefs and attributions of mind to non-human entities that are culturally accepted and widespread.

title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
summary: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.

title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
summary: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.

title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
summary: Visual generation increasingly requires high-resolution images, long videos, and multimodal context, making the quadratic cost of full attention prohibitive. We introduce Chimera, a hybrid visual diffusion backbone with a principled scaling recipe. Chimera processes text, image, and video tokens in one raster-ordered stream without positional embeddings. It combines Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) for long-context state tracking with O(N) complexity, interleaved Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for direct global interaction, and modality-aware short convolutions for local spatiotemporal context. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers expand capacity while controlling activated compute. To scale this heterogeneous architecture, we introduce HeteroP, a module-wise scheme that transfers hyperparameters across width and depth according to each tensor's functional fan-in and model depth. HeteroP yields a consistently tuned family used to fit Chinchilla-style compute-optimal laws for activated model size, training-token count, and image-video data ratio. Guided by these laws, we train an 11B-parameter Chimera with 2B activated parameters. Experiments show three results. First, measured by pretraining diffusion loss, the dense backbone is 1.7x as compute-efficient as a matched full-attention Wan-2.1 2B baseline, while the complete system reaches 7.3x. Second, without length-specific fine-tuning, Chimera extrapolates zero-shot from 5-second training clips to 30-second videos, with only 6.5% FID degradation in the last five seconds. Third, the fitted laws show that compute-optimal image pretraining divides compute nearly evenly between activated model size and training-token count, whereas video pretraining modestly favors model size at higher budgets. These results establish a foundation for designing and scaling efficient long-context diffusion architectures.

title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
summary: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
summary: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.

title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
summary: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.

title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
summary: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision and use it to explicitly reason about how the physical world evolves. Accordingly, PhiZero adopts a reason-then-render paradigm: it first infers future world evolution as a physical-language sequence and then renders the inferred transitions into videos. Extensive experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks validate the ability of PhiZero to model physically coherent world evolution. We further show its potential for realistic and interactive world modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.

title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
summary: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time. Existing datasets fragment this experience across viewpoints, modalities, or spatial scales, leaving the full perception-action loop only partially observed. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios. ACE operates at two complementary scales: a table-scale configuration resolves hand-object manipulation, while a room-scale configuration captures whole-body motion, locomotion, and interactions across a furnished home. ACE records egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, full-body and articulated hand motion, object geometry and 6-DoF trajectories, audio, and tactile signals as a unified multisensory stream. Using ACE, we build ACE-Data-0, comprising 150 hours and 17M video frames across 200 task categories, performed by 50 participants in 2 environments, for a total of 75,000 interaction episodes. The dataset spans atomic manipulation, long-horizon chains of household activities, and human-scene interaction, while preserving natural behavioral variation through goal-level rather than step-by-step instructions. We further introduce a hierarchical benchmark that progresses from signals to scene components and then to interactions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art methods expose substantial gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long temporal horizons. ACE-Data-0 provides synchronized human demonstrations with aligned perceptual, kinematic, and contact supervision, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, vision-language-action systems, and embodied AI.

AI.title_translation: ACE-Data-0：作为具身数据引擎的以人为中心环境采集
AI.tldr: 本文提出了环境采集引擎（ACE）及大规模数据集ACE-Data-0，通过空间标定与时间同步的多模态流，为具身智能提供了高质量、全方位的以人为中心的交互数据和评估基准。
AI.motivation: 具身智能面临根本性的数据瓶颈。模型需要捕捉第一视角感知、全身运动、灵巧操作、物体状态、声音和触觉在人类实现目标过程中的协同演化，而现有数据集在视角、模态或空间尺度上割裂了这些体验，导致感知-动作闭环无法被完整观测。
AI.method: 开发了以人为中心的环境采集引擎（ACE），将真实家居环境转变为空间标定、时间同步的录制工作室。ACE分为桌面级（手部-物体操作）和房间级（全身运动与跨场景交互）两种配置，可同时记录自我中心/多视角非自我中心视频、全身与双手运动、物体几何及6-DoF轨迹、音频和触觉信号。基于ACE构建了ACE-Data-0数据集，并提出了从信号到场景组件再到交互的分层评估基准。
AI.result: 构建了包含150小时、1700万视频帧、200个任务类别、50名参与者在2个环境中完成的75,000个交互片段数据集ACE-Data-0。在分层基准上的评估显示，现有SOTA方法在面对接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时序范围时仍存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Data-0提供了具有对齐感知、运动学和接触监督的同步人类示范数据，为模仿学习、世界模型、视觉-语言-动作系统及具身人工智能奠定了可扩展的基础。
AI.translation: 具身智能面临着根本性的数据瓶颈。模型必须捕捉自我中心感知、全身运动、灵巧操作、物体状态、声音和触觉如何在人类追求目标的过程中共同演化。现有的数据集在视角、模态或空间尺度上割裂了这种体验，使得完整的“感知-动作”闭环仅被部分观察到。我们引入了环境采集引擎（ACE），这是一个以人为中心的数据引擎，可将真实的家庭环境转化为经过空间标定和时间同步的录制工作室。ACE在两个互补的尺度上运行：桌面级配置解决手部与物体的操作，而房间级配置捕捉包含家具的整个家庭中的全身运动、移动和交互。ACE将自我中心和多视角非自我中心视频、全身和关节化手部运动、物体几何形状和6自由度轨迹、音频以及触觉信号记录为统一的多感官流。使用ACE，我们构建了ACE-Data-0，包含150小时和1700万视频帧，涵盖200个任务类别，由50名参与者在2个环境中完成，共计75,000个交互片段。该数据集涵盖原子级操作、长时序家庭活动链和人-场景交互，同时通过目标层级而非按部就班的指令保留了自然的行为变化。我们进一步引入了一个分层基准，从信号推进到场景组件，再到交互。对现有最新（SOTA）方法的评估揭示了在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时序范围内存在的巨大差距。ACE-Data-0提供了具有对齐的感知、运动学和接触监督的同步人类示范，为模仿学习、世界模型、视觉-语言-动作系统和具身AI提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.summary: 针对具身智能中多模态数据割裂与观测不完整的问题，本文提出了以人为中心的环境采集引擎（ACE）。ACE支持桌面级和房间级两种尺度，能同步采集多视角视频、运动姿态、物体几何与姿态、音频及触觉等多模态信号。利用ACE构建的ACE-Data-0数据集包含150小时、7.5万个交互片段，覆盖丰富的家庭日常任务。评测表明现有方法在复杂接触和长时序任务上仍有巨大提升空间，该数据集为具身AI提供了坚实的数据基础。
AI.keywords: Embodied Intelligence, Multi-modal Dataset, Ambient Capture, Human-Object Interaction, Embodied AI
AI.comments:
创新性：ACE系统通过软硬件一体的设计，将真实家庭环境转化为多视角、多模态全同步的采集工作室，克服了以往数据集在视角、模态和空间尺度上的割裂。
重要性：ACE-Data-0提供了高达150小时、包含高质量动作/触觉/几何姿态的大规模对齐数据，并建立了从信号到交互的分层基准，对模仿学习、世界模型及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型的发展具有重要推动作用。
局限性：目前数据集仅涵盖2个真实家庭环境，在场景泛化性方面可能仍有扩展空间；此外多模态设备的硬件标定与同步部署成本相对较高。

title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
summary: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benchmarks: on Visual Haystacks it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative), and on LVBench it transfers zero-shot to long video for an 8.0-point gain with Qwen3VL-8B. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken

AI.title_translation: ReToken：单个Token提升视觉语言模型的视觉检索能力
AI.tldr: 本文提出ReToken，通过训练单个检索Token从预填充的视觉KV Cache中动态挑选关键视觉信息，以极低的计算代价显著提升多模态大模型在长图与长视频检索中的性能。
AI.motivation: 长视觉上下文会导致视觉语言模型在干扰项增多时性能严重下降，且受到GPU显存限制，一次性处理所有视觉Token在计算上难以承受。
AI.method: 提出了ReToken方法：引入一个训练为显式检索目标的单个可学习嵌入（embedding），用于从预填充的视觉KV Cache中精准挑选一小部分与文本查询高度相关的稀疏视觉Token。
AI.result:
仅在小型图像问答数据集上训练后：
1. Visual Haystacks基准：将Qwen3VL-8B提升13.4分，InternVL3.5提升12.4分（相对提升超过20%）；
2. LVBench长视频基准：零样本迁移至长视频，使Qwen3VL-8B性能提升8.0分；
3. 计算效率：训练及长视频推理均可在单张H100 GPU上轻松完成。
AI.conclusion: ReToken提供了一种极轻量且高效的视觉Token检索方案，有效解决了多模态大模型在长视觉上下文下的计算瓶颈与性能衰减问题，具有优异的跨域泛化能力。
AI.translation: 长视觉上下文给视觉语言模型带来了严峻挑战：随着干扰项数量的增加，模型性能会发生衰减，且在GPU显存限制下一次性处理所有Token在计算上不可行。我们提出了ReToken，这是一个作为显式检索目标训练的单个可学习嵌入，能够从预填充的视觉KV Cache中选择一小部分与查询相关的稀疏视觉Token。仅在小型图像问答数据集上训练，ReToken就在图像和视频基准测试中取得了持续的性能提升：在Visual Haystacks上，它将Qwen3VL-8B提升了13.4分，将InternVL3.5提升了12.4分（相对提升超过20%）；在LVBench上，它成功零样本迁移到长视频任务，使Qwen3VL-8B获得了8.0分的提升。得益于其轻量化设计，训练与长视频推理均可在单张H100显卡上完成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ReToken，一种用于改进视觉语言模型长上下文视觉检索的轻量级方法。ReToken通过单个可学习Token从预填充的KV Cache中高效筛选关键视觉信息，在大幅降低显存开销的同时，在长图和长视频基准测试中均取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 视觉检索, KV Cache, 长视觉上下文, 稀疏选择
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：设计极其巧妙且高效，仅引入单个可学习Token作为显式检索目标，巧妙避开了传统全注意力的计算与显存瓶颈；
2. 实用性：资源消耗极低，训练与推理均可在单张H100 GPU上运行，且具备极强的图像到长视频零样本迁移能力；
3. 局限性：极高度稀疏化选择可能在面对需要多图/多帧极细粒度全局综合推理的任务时丢失微小的边缘上下文信息。

title: Estimating Treatment Effects for Depression in Longitudinal Therapy Switching Settings
comments: Accepted as an Oral Presentation at the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference (EMBC) 2026
summary: Depression treatment often requires switching medications due to inadequate response or adverse effects. Estimating individualized treatment effects in this setting is challenging because treatment assignment is confounded by patient characteristics, switching induces time-varying selection, and counterfactual outcomes are not observed in follow-up data. Using a proprietary longitudinal major depressive disorder (MDD) clinical trial dataset, we formulate a next-visit counterfactual prediction task to estimate Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD-17) total scores under alternative treatments. We benchmark 8 estimators, including meta-learners, residual-based methods, and tree-based approaches. Causal Forest (CF) demonstrates the most favorable and consistent performance across all criteria. Our analysis shows that symptom benefits concentrate in specific switch directions, with dose intensification being generally beneficial. Notably, we identify a counterintuitive exception where a lower-intensity regimen outperforms a higher-intensity alternative for specific patient subsets. While crude observational comparisons substantially overstate gains, confounding-adjusted estimates yield modest, actionable magnitudes. These findings provide prospectively testable candidates for clinical decision support in depression care.
comment: Accepted as an Oral Presentation at the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference (EMBC) 2026

AI.title_translation: 纵向治疗切换场景下抑郁症治疗效果的估计
AI.tldr: 研究评估了8种因果机器学习模型在抑郁症药物切换场景下的反事实预测表现，发现因果森林模型最为有效，且消除混杂偏差后的估计为临床决策提供了切实可行的依据。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症治疗常因疗效不足或副作用而需要更换药物。在此场景下评估个体化治疗效果十分困难，主要归因于患者特征造成的治疗分配混杂、更换药物引入的时变选择偏差，以及随访数据中反事实结果不可观测。
AI.method: 利用专有的纵向重度抑郁症（MDD）临床试验数据集，构建下一次随访的反事实预测任务，以评估替代治疗方案下的汉密尔顿抑郁量表（HAMD-17）总分。系统对比了包括元学习器（meta-learners）、基于残差的方法以及基于树的方法在内的8种因果估计器。
AI.result: 因果森林（Causal Forest, CF）在所有评估指标中均展现出最优且最稳定的性能。分析表明症状改善集中在特定的切换方向，普遍增加剂量是有益的；但同时也发现了一个反直觉的例外——在特定患者子集中，低强度方案表现优于高强度方案。此外，未调整混杂的观察性比较严重高估了治疗收益，而混杂调整后的估计则给出了温和且具备实际临床指导意义的收益幅度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了抑郁症切换用药及剂量调整的效应模式，为开发抑郁症临床决策支持系统提供了具有前瞻性可测试价值的候选方案。
AI.translation: 抑郁症治疗通常由于响应不足或不良反应而需要更换药物。在此场景下估计个体化治疗效果具有挑战性，因为治疗分配受到患者特征的混杂，药物切换会诱发时变选择，且在随访数据中观察不到反事实结果。利用专有的纵向重度抑郁症（MDD）临床试验数据集，我们构思了一个下一次随访的反事实预测任务，以估计替代治疗方案下的汉密尔顿抑郁量表（HAMD-17）总分。我们对包括元学习器、基于残差的方法和基于树的方法在内的8种估计器进行了基准测试。因果森林（CF）在所有标准中表现出最有利且一致的性能。我们的分析表明，症状收益集中在特定的切换方向，增加剂量普遍有益。值得注意的是，我们发现了一个反直觉的例外，即对于特定的患者子集，较低强度的方案优于较高强度的替代方案。虽然粗略的观察性比较大幅高估了收益，但调整混杂因素后的估计给出了温和且具有可操作性的幅度。这些发现为抑郁症护理中的临床决策支持提供了可进行前瞻性测试的候选方案。
AI.summary: 本研究针对抑郁症纵向治疗切换中的因果效应评估难题，构建了下一次随访的反事实预测框架，对8种因果机器学习方法进行了对比基准测试。研究发现因果森林模型表现最佳，调整混杂后的估计纠正了传统观察性比较对疗效的高估，并揭示了不同用药切换策略与剂量调整对抑郁症状的具体影响，为抑郁症个体化决策提供了依据。
AI.keywords: 抑郁症治疗, 因果推断, 药物切换, 因果森林, HAMD-17
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将因果推断框架应用于纵向抑郁症药物切换的动态场景，并对8种因果机器学习估计器进行了系统基准测试。其重要性在于指出了未调整混杂的粗略比较会严重高估疗效，并发现了某些患者子集中低强度方案优于高强度方案的反直觉临床见解。局限性在于研究依赖专有临床试验数据，通用性需进一步验证，且反事实预测结果仍需前瞻性临床随机对照试验来最终证实。

title: Foundation-Model Earth Representations Enable Regional-Scale Forest Aboveground Biomass Monitoring Across the Northeastern United States
summary: Forest aboveground biomass (AGB) is a critical indicator of ecosystem productivity and terrestrial carbon storage, yet regional carbon monitoring remains constrained by the sparse spatial and temporal availability of field inventories and airborne structural measurements. Recent Earth observation foundation models provide globally consistent geospatial representations derived from diverse multimodal datasets, offering a potential pathway toward scalable biomass monitoring. Here, we evaluate Google Satellite Embeddings (GSE), generated by the AplphaEarth Foundation Model, for regional-scale AGB estimation across diverse temperate forest ecosystems in the northeastern United States. We integrated annual GSE observations, airborne LiDAR, and continuous forest inventory measurements from the Northeastern Forest Inventory Network (NEFIN) within a machine-learning framework. Combined LiDAR-GSE models achieved an R^2 of 0.79 for AGB estimation. Capitalizing on annual GSE observations expanded the training dataset by more than tenfold through temporal growth adjustment, increasing predictive performance to R^2 = 0.82 while reducing model bias by over 70%. Spatial autocorrelation analyses showed that integrating foundation-model representations and structural predictors substantially reduced residual spatial dependence. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrated that hyperparameter optimization reduced model-performance variability by 27.9%. Our findings demonstrate that foundation-model Earth representations capture ecologically meaningful information relevant to forest biomass and provide a scalable framework for annual carbon monitoring in regions with incomplete airborne LiDAR coverage. Our fundings establish a pathway toward next-generation forest carbon assessment based on globally available foundation-model Earth observations.

AI.title_translation: 地球遥感基础模型表示赋能美国东北部区域尺度森林地上生物量监测
AI.tldr: 利用 AlphaEarth 遥感基础模型派生的 Google 卫星嵌入（GSE）结合机载 LiDAR 与地面调查数据，实现了美国东北部高精度、低偏差的区域尺度森林地上生物量年度监测。
AI.motivation: 森林地上生物量（AGB）是碳循环监测的核心指标，但由于地面样方调查和机载 LiDAR 等高精度结构测量数据在时空分布上极为稀疏，限制了区域尺度森林碳储量的连续、高精度监测。
AI.method: 利用 AlphaEarth 基础模型生成的 Google 卫星嵌入（GSE）表示，结合机载 LiDAR 数据和东北森林调查网络（NEFIN）的连续地面调查数据，构建机器学习估算框架；利用年度 GSE 观测通过时间生长调整将训练数据集扩大十倍以上，并结合蒙特卡洛模拟和空间自相关分析优化模型参数与结构。
AI.result: LiDAR 与 GSE 结合的模型估算 AGB 的 R^2 达到 0.79；通过 GSE 进行时间生长调整扩大训练集后，R^2 提升至 0.82，模型偏差降低超过 70%；空间自相关分析表明残差的空间依赖性显著降低；超参数优化使模型性能波动减少了 27.9%。
AI.conclusion: 地球科学基础模型能够有效捕获与森林生物量相关的生态特征信息，为机载 LiDAR 数据覆盖不全区域的年度森林碳监测提供了高度可扩展的解决方案，为下一代森林碳评估奠定了坚实基础。
AI.translation: 森林地上生物量（AGB）是生态系统生产力和陆地碳储量的关键指标，但区域碳监测一直受限于地面调查和机载结构测量在空间和时间上的稀疏性。最近的地球观测基础模型提供了由多元多模态数据集派生的全球一致地理空间表示，为可扩展的生物量监测提供了潜在途径。在本研究中，我们评估了由 AlphaEarth 基础模型生成的 Google 卫星嵌入（GSE），用于在美国东北部多样化的温带森林生态系统中进行区域尺度 AGB 估算。我们在机器学习框架内整合了年度 GSE 观测数据、机载 LiDAR 以及来自东北森林调查网络（NEFIN）的连续森林调查测量数据。组合的 LiDAR-GSE 模型在 AGB 估算中达到了 0.79 的 R^2。利用年度 GSE 观测数据通过时间生长调整将训练数据集扩大了十倍以上，使预测性能提高到 R^2 = 0.82，同时将模型偏差降低了 70% 以上。空间自相关分析表明，结合基础模型表示和结构预测变量显著降低了残差的空间相关性。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，超参数优化将模型性能的不确定性降低了 27.9%。我们的研究结果表明，基础模型的地球表示能够捕获与森林生物量相关的具有生态意义的信息，并为机载 LiDAR 覆盖不全区域的年度碳监测提供了一个可扩展的框架。我们的研究为基于全球可用的基础模型地球观测进行下一代森林碳评估奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了 AlphaEarth 基础模型派生的 Google 卫星嵌入（GSE）在美国东北部森林地上生物量（AGB）估算中的表现。通过将 GSE、机载 LiDAR 和地面调查数据结合入机器学习框架，并利用 GSE 扩展训练样本，研究实现了高精度（R^2=0.82）、低偏差的区域尺度 AGB 监测，为缺乏连续 LiDAR 的区域提供了可扩展的碳评估方法。
AI.keywords: 森林地上生物量, 基础模型, Google卫星嵌入, 碳监测, 机载LiDAR
AI.comments: 本文将近年来遥感基础模型（AlphaEarth）的通用空间嵌入表示（GSE）应用于森林生物量估算，展示了遥感大模型在缺乏高精度连续机载 LiDAR 数据时的替代与增效潜力。其创新点在于通过 GSE 结合时间生长调整将训练集扩大十倍以上，极大地降低了预测偏差并显著提升了空间外推稳定性，为大规模森林碳评估提供了高性价比的新范式。

title: Psych-ECA: A Reproducible Semi-Synthetic Benchmark for Synthetic Control Arms in Longitudinal Psychiatry
summary: External and synthetic control arms (ECAs) are entering psychiatric drug development, but the field lacks a benchmark that evaluates the properties regulators care about: not only how accurately a method reconstructs untreated trajectories, but whether its uncertainty is calibrated, whether it is robust to the informative observation times common in mental-health records (sicker patients are seen more often), and what false-positive rate it induces in go/no-go trial decisions. Real psychiatric trial data (e.g. STAR-D and registry cohorts) require credentialed access and lack ground-truth counterfactuals, so, following established semi-synthetic benchmarks in causal inference (IHDP, ACIC, and the PK-PD tumor-growth simulator), we release Psych-ECA, a fully reproducible generator of longitudinal symptom trajectories for depression (PHQ-9), anxiety (HAM-A), and psychosis (PANSS) with known counterfactual control arms, informative visits, and validated-scale measurement noise. We benchmark eight estimators spanning carry-forward, pooled real-world-data averages, nearest-neighbour matching, linear mixed models, gradient boosting, and the Scribe trajectory-bridge method. Three findings emerge. First, trajectory and flexible machine learning methods achieve the best counterfactual accuracy (about 2.3 PHQ-9 RMSE), outperforming cross-sectional baselines. Second, only Scribe is both accurate and calibrated, achieving 93-96% empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals, compared with 87-88% for gradient boosting and 62-75% for uncalibrated SDE models. Third, inverse-intensity correction reduces bias under informative sampling, while Scribe's calibrated intervals are the only trajectory method that maintains nominal false-positive rates as informativeness increases. We release all code, data-generation scripts, and random seeds to enable fully reproducible evaluation.

AI.title_translation: Psych-ECA：纵向精神病学中合成对照臂的可重复半合成基准
AI.tldr: 提出了 Psych-ECA——首个可重复的精神病学合成对照臂半合成基准，评估了8种方法在反事实预测、不确定性校准及信息性采样下的表现。
AI.motivation: 合成对照臂（ECA）正在进入精神病学药物研发，但缺乏能够全面评估监管机构关注指标的基准测试（不仅需要预测准确性，还需评估不确定性校准、对信息性观测时间的鲁棒性以及诱导的假阳性率）。同时真实临床试验数据存在权限限制且缺乏反事实真值。
AI.method: 开发了 Psych-ECA，这是一个完全可复现的半合成纵向症状轨迹生成器，涵盖抑郁症（PHQ-9）、焦虑症（HAM-A）和精神病（PANSS），具备已知反事实对照臂、信息性随访（病情越重就诊越频繁）以及量表测量噪声。基于该基准评估了包含前向延续法、汇总RWD均值、最近邻匹配、线性混合模型、梯度提升树及 Scribe 轨迹桥接在内的 8 种估计器。
AI.result:
1. 轨迹与灵活的机器学习方法取得最佳反事实预测准确度（PHQ-9 RMSE 约 2.3），显著优于截面基线；
2. 仅有 Scribe 能够同时满足准确度与校准度需求，在 90% 标称预测区间上达到 93-96% 的经验覆盖率；
3. 逆强度矫正（Inverse-intensity correction）可显著减少信息性采样带来的偏差，且 Scribe 是唯一能在随访信息性增加时保持标称假阳性率的轨迹方法。
AI.conclusion: Psych-ECA 为精神病学领域的合成对照臂研究提供了首个完全开源、可重复且包含因果反事实真值的半合成基准。实验表明，轨迹和灵活的机器学习方法能够提升反事实预测准确度，且只有具备良好不确定性校准的方法（如 Scribe）才能在信息性采样的复杂场景下有效控制决策假阳性率。
AI.translation: 外部和合成对照臂（ECA）正进入精神病学药物开发领域，但该领域缺乏能够评估监管机构所关注特性的基准：不仅包括方法重构未治疗轨迹的准确度，还包括其不确定性是否经过校准、对精神健康记录中常见的信息性观测时间（病情较重患者就诊更频繁）是否具有鲁棒性，以及它在 go/no-go 试验决策中引发的假阳性率。真实的精神病学试验数据（如 STAR-D 和注册库队列）需要授权访问且缺乏因果反事实真值，因此，借鉴因果推断中建立的半合成基准（IHDP、ACIC 和 PK-PD 肿瘤生长模拟器），我们发布了 Psych-ECA，这是一个完全可重复的抑郁症（PHQ-9）、焦虑症（HAM-A）和精神病（PANSS）纵向症状轨迹生成器，具有已知反事实对照臂、信息性随访和经过验证的量表测量噪声。我们对涵盖前向延续、汇总真实世界数据均值、最近邻匹配、线性混合模型、梯度提升以及 Scribe 轨迹桥接方法的八种估计器进行了基准测试。得出了三个发现：首先，轨迹与灵活的机器学习方法实现了最佳的反事实准确度（PHQ-9 RMSE 约为 2.3），优于截面基准。其次，只有 Scribe 既准确又经过校准，在 90% 的标称预测区间上达到了 93-96% 的经验覆盖率，而梯度提升为 87-88%，未校准的 SDE 模型为 62-75%。第三，逆强度校正在信息性采样下减少了偏差，而随着信息性的增加，Scribe 的校准区间是唯一能够保持标称假阳性率的轨迹方法。我们开源了所有代码、数据生成脚本和随机种子，以实现完全可重复的评估。
AI.summary: 本研究推出了 Psych-ECA，一个针对纵向精神病学合成对照臂（ECA）的完全可复现半合成评估基准。该基准包含了抑郁、焦虑和精神病的纵向症状轨迹及已知反事实真值，并模拟了真实临床中重症患者随访更频繁的信息性采样特征。通过对8种主流与先进因果估计器的对比评估，研究揭示了轨迹机器学习方法的准确度优势，并证明了不确定性校准与逆强度校正在控制试验假阳性率方面的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 合成对照臂, 纵向精神病学, 因果推断基准, 不确定性校准, 信息性采样
AI.comments: 该论文填补了精神病学与因果推断交叉领域缺乏高质量、完全可复现合成对照臂（ECA）评估基准的空白。其创新之处在于不仅评估反事实预测准确性，还首次将精神科临床数据中极具代表性的“信息性采样/观测”以及不确定性校准（假阳性率控制）纳入基准测试逻辑中，对后续精神药物研发的监管决策具有重要参考价值。开源代码和数据集生成流程确保了极高的复现性和社区实用性。

title: Evolutionary dynamics of collective decision-making with local social influence on static and dynamic networks
summary: Collective decision-making is ubiquitous across the living world and artificial societies. Individuals often choose an option based on intrinsic values of options. However, individual decision-making is also swayed by neighbors' choices, generating local social influence. Hence, an important question arises naturally, yet remains unanswered: when such social influence is integrated into the individual evaluation process for option choices, how does it affect collective decision-making outcomes in structured populations modeled by graphs. To address this, we consider a baseline model of binary options with social influence and assume that individuals not only evaluate the intrinsic values of options, but are also influenced by their neighbors' choices. We propose a perceived utility function integrating these two aspects for individual decision-making. By means of theoretical analysis, we first derive the average frequency of an option on static weighted connected graphs and present the mathematical condition under which this option prevails in the population. We find that the introduction of social influence can amplify the advantage of a superior option or compensate for the deficiency of an inferior one. We also reveal that the average degree of network exerts a dual effect on collective decision outcomes. Furthermore, we consider our evolutionary model on dynamic networks switching among distinct graph configurations. Our theoretical analysis shows that the evolutionary outcomes depend not only on the average degree of each network configuration, but also on its expected duration. We perform computer simulations to verify our theoretical predictions on static and dynamic networks.

AI.title_translation: 静态与动态网络上具局部社会影响的群体决策演化动力学
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了局部社会影响与选项内在价值如何共同塑造静态及动态网络上的群体决策演化结果。
AI.motivation: 探究当局部社会影响整合到个体对选项的评估过程中时，如何影响通过图建模的结构化群体中的群体决策演化结果。
AI.method: 提出了一个整合选项内在价值与邻居选择影响的感知效用函数，构建了二元选项演化模型；运用理论分析推导了静态加权连通图及动态切换网络上选项的平均频率与占优数学条件，并结合计算机仿真进行验证。
AI.result: 社会影响能放大优劣选项的优势或弥补其不足；网络平均度对群体决策结果具有双重效应；在动态网络中，演化结果取决于各网络配置的平均度及其预期持续时间。
AI.conclusion: 社会影响与网络拓扑特性（如平均度及动态配置持续时间）协同决定了群体决策的演化方向与结果。
AI.translation: 群体决策在自然界和人工社会中无处不在。个体通常根据选项的内在价值做出选择。然而，个体的决策也会受到邻居选择的影响，从而产生局部社会影响。因此，提出了一个自然且尚未解决的重要问题：当这种社会影响被整合到个体对选项选择的评估过程中时，它将如何影响由图建模的结构化群体中的群体决策结果？为了解决这个问题，我们考虑了一个带有社会影响的二元选项基线模型，并假设个体不仅评估选项的内在价值，还受到邻居选择的影响。我们提出了一个整合这两个方面的感知效用函数用于个体决策。通过理论分析，我们首先推导了静态加权连通图上某一选项的平均频率，并给出了该选项在群体中占据主导地位的数学条件。我们发现引入社会影响可以放大优质选项的优势或弥补劣质选项的不足。我们还揭示了网络的平均度对群体决策结果具有双重效应。此外，我们还将演化模型推广到在不同图配置之间切换的动态网络上。理论分析表明，演化结果不仅取决于每个网络配置的平均度，还取决于其预期持续时间。我们进行了计算机仿真，验证了在静态和动态网络上的理论预测。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有局部社会影响的群体决策在静态和动态网络上的演化动力学。通过引入整合选项内在价值与邻居选择影响的感知效用函数，作者推导了静态加权连通网络上选项占优的数学条件，揭示了社会影响的作用机制及网络平均度的双重效应；随后将模型推广至动态切换网络，阐明了网络平均度和持续时间对演化结果的协同影响，并通过计算机仿真证实了理论分析的正确性。
AI.keywords: 群体决策, 局部社会影响, 演化动力学, 静态网络, 动态网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将个体对选项内在价值的评估与邻居节点的局部社会影响相结合，提出了统一的感知效用函数，并将其从静态加权网络拓展至动态切换网络。研究不仅给出了严谨的数学条件推导，还揭示了网络平均度的双重效应以及动态网络持续时间的调控作用，对理解复杂网络上的群体决策、舆论传播及社会动力学具有重要理论价值。

title: Data Field Theory: Theory and Applications of the Functional Renormalization Group for Signal Detection
summary: We review the renormalization group framework for signal detection in high-dimensional data, tailored to the regime where the signal may be of extensive rank and does not separate from the noise bulk as isolated spikes. The framework provides a conceptually simple criterion for distinguishing signal from noise within a quasi-continuous spectral region near a random-matrix universality class. This scenario lies beyond the reach of standard methods such as the Baik-Ben Arous-Péché threshold, which requires eigenvalues to be cleanly separated from the bulk. The renormalization group approach, by contrast, directly tracks spectral deformations and consistently yields a lower limit of detection without relying on spike separation. We review results that identify the presence of a signal by testing the stability of the Gaussian fixed point of an effective field theory for the collective behaviour of the degrees of freedom in the spectral tail, where the signal resides. We also discuss how the scale dependence of the canonical dimension, induced by the signal, manifests as a dimensional phase transition.

AI.title_translation: 数据场论：用于信号检测的泛函重整化群理论与应用
AI.tldr: 基于重整化群与有效场论，本文综述了一种无需孤立特征值尖峰即可在高维噪声中检测广泛秩信号的新框架。
AI.motivation: 传统高维信号检测方法（如BBP阈值）依赖于信号特征值与噪声主体的孤立分离。然而当信号具有广泛秩且未能分离为孤立尖峰时，传统方法失效。
AI.method: 利用泛函重整化群与有效场论框架，通过测试信号所在谱尾部自由度集体行为的高斯固定点稳定性，直接追踪谱变形来检测信号。
AI.result: 该方法无需依赖特征值尖峰分离即可稳定给出信号检测下限，并揭示了由信号诱导的规范维度尺度依赖性所表现出的维度相变。
AI.conclusion: 重整化群框架为在准连续谱区域内区分信号与噪声提供了切实可行的判据，成功扩展了高维信号检测的理论边界。
AI.translation: 我们综述了用于高维数据信号检测的重整化群框架，该框架专门针对信号可能具有广泛秩且不作为孤立尖峰与噪声主体分离的情形。该框架提供了一个概念上简单的准则，用于在靠近随机矩阵普遍性类的准连续谱区域内区分信号与噪声。这一场景超出了标准方法（如要求特征值与主体清晰分离的Baik-Ben Arous-Péché阈值）的能力范围。相比之下，重整化群方法直接追踪谱变形，并在不依赖尖峰分离的情况下持续给出检测下限。我们综述了通过测试信号所在谱尾部自由度集体行为的有效场论高斯固定点的稳定性来识别信号存在的成果。我们还讨论了由信号诱导的规范维度的尺度依赖性如何表现为维度相变。
AI.summary: 本综述介绍了一种基于泛函重整化群的高维数据信号检测框架。针对信号未与噪声主体孤立分离、呈现广泛秩的难题，该方法通过评估有效场论高斯固定点的稳定性来直接捕捉谱变形，从而建立起一套无需尖峰分离的信号检测准则与相变机制。
AI.keywords: 重整化群, 信号检测, 高维数据, 有效场论, 随机矩阵
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将物理学中的泛函重整化群与有效场论引入高维数据分析领域，突破了传统随机矩阵理论（如BBP阈值）对孤立尖峰特征值的依赖，为检测混杂在噪声谱尾部中的广泛秩信号提供了全新的视角和理论工具。

title: More Data, Worse Decisions? Preference Reversals in Neural Networks under Gram Incompatibility
summary: Neural networks increasingly combine data across populations, time periods, and operating conditions to improve generalization. This raises a reliability question: whether a model refitted on pooled data preserves an action ordering supported by both sources. Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) formalizes this requirement through its composition axiom, which requires source-supported preferences to survive their union. We study when this property holds for fixed-representation neural networks with ordinary least squares (OLS) output heads. First, we show that pooled refitting recomputes the inverse-Gram geometry used to weight source evidence, which can reverse shared preferences, and derive exact and approximate preservation conditions. Next, we introduce a scale-invariant Gram mismatch measure for prioritizing candidate pools and geometry-oriented regularization for shaping source geometry during training. Finally, we develop a three-stage audit that traces strict pairwise reversals through decision changes to task-defined utility loss. Experiments spanning a load-based bidding proxy and medical and financial decision proxies reveal stable and reversal-prone pooling regimes: the load audit identifies a measurable nonzero class of source-consensus-relative harmful decisions under the proxy utility, while cross-domain audits show that comparable mismatch can correspond to sharply different preservation rates. Geometry-oriented objectives occupy distinct descriptive accuracy-consistency-geometry-harm operating points. Together, the framework makes compositional reliability measurable and operational through screening, analytic certification, geometry-oriented training, and decision-consequence auditing.

AI.title_translation: 更多数据，更差决策？Gram不兼容下神经网络中的偏好逆转
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了神经网络合并多源数据时因逆Gram几何改变导致偏好逆转的现象，并提出了评估失配、几何正则化训练与决策后果审计的可靠性框架。
AI.motivation: 神经网络常通过跨群体、时间段和运行条件合并数据来提升泛化能力，但这引发了组合可靠性问题：合并数据上重新拟合的模型能否保持两个数据源共同支持的动作排序（即满足案例决策理论中的组合公理）。
AI.method:
1. 基于固定表示与普通最小二乘法（OLS）输出头，证明池化重拟合重新计算逆Gram几何会引发偏好逆转，并推导出偏好保持的精确与近似条件。
2. 提出标度不变的Gram失配度量以筛选数据池，并设计面向几何的正则化以在训练中塑造数据源几何。
3. 开发三阶段审计流程，将成对偏好逆转追踪到具体的决策改变及任务效用损失。
AI.result: 在负荷竞价、医疗和金融决策代理实验中发现：存在稳定与易逆转的数据池化机制；负荷审计识别出非零比例的损害性决策；跨领域实验表明相似的Gram失配度可能对应截然不同的偏好保持率；面向几何的训练目标在准确率、一致性与效用损失之间展现出独特的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的框架通过筛选、分析认证、面向几何的训练和决策后果审计，使得神经网络在多源数据合并时的组合可靠性变得可度量和可操作。
AI.translation: 神经网络越来越多地跨群体、时间段和运行条件合并数据以提高泛化能力。这引发了一个可靠性问题：在合并数据上重新拟合的模型是否能够保持两个数据源均支持的动作顺序。基于案例的决策理论（CBDT）通过其组合公理将这一要求形式化，该公理要求源支持的偏好在其并集中得以保留。我们研究了这一性质在具有普通最小二乘法（OLS）输出头的固定表示神经网络中何时成立。首先，我们证明了池化重新拟合会重新计算用于对源证据加权的逆Gram几何，这可能会逆转共享偏好，并推导出精确和近似的保持条件。其次，我们引入了一种标度不变的Gram失配度量来优先选择候选数据池，并引入面向几何的正则化，以在训练期间塑造源几何。最后，我们开发了一个三阶段审计，将严格的成对逆转通过决策变化追踪到任务定义的效用损失。涵盖基于负荷的竞价代理以及医疗和金融决策代理的实验揭示了稳定和易发生逆转的池化机制：负荷审计在代理效用下识别出一个可测量的非零类的源共识相对伤害决策，而跨领域审计表明相当的失配可以对应截然不同的保持率。面向几何的目标占据了截然不同的描述准确性-一致性-几何-伤害操作点。总之，该框架通过筛选、分析认证、面向几何的训练和决策后果审计，使得组合可靠性可度量且可操作。
AI.summary: 本文研究了神经网络合并多源数据时因Gram不兼容性导致的偏好逆转现象（即数据增多反而导致决策变差）。作者基于案例决策理论，分析了固定表示模型在数据池化时逆Gram几何对偏好保持的影响，导出了理论条件，并提出了Gram失配度量、面向几何的正则化训练方法以及三阶段决策审计框架，为评估和提升多源数据融合决策的可靠性提供了完整方案。
AI.keywords: 偏好逆转, 组合可靠性, Gram不兼容性, 数据池化, 神经网络决策
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将基于案例决策理论（CBDT）的组合公理引入神经网络数据合并场景，揭示了“数据增多可能导致偏好逆转与决策变差”这一反直觉且关键的可靠性隐患。通过逆Gram几何视角给出了理论解释，并提出了从几何失配度量、面向几何训练到后果审计的完整解决方案，对医疗、金融等高风险应用中的多源数据融合决策具有重要价值。

title: PlantBGC: Transformer for Plant BGC Discovery via Label-Free Domain Adaptation and Weak Supervision
summary: Plant biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) encode specialized-metabolite pathways, yet curated plant BGC labels remain scarce, hindering supervised discovery at genome scale. Existing plant BGC mining tools are largely signature- and rule-driven and do not fully leverage recent advances in contextual representation learning for modeling long-range domain context and controlling false positives under strong domain shift. We seek an AI-assisted workflow that narrows experimental search space by transferring supervision from well-annotated microbial BGCs to plant genomes. We present PlantBGC, representing genomes as ordered Pfam-domain sequences and learning BGC-likeness with an encoder-only Transformer trained on MIBiG microbial BGCs and adapted to plants via label-free masked language modeling. On microbial benchmarks, PlantBGC achieves token-level AUC = 0.988 (10-fold CV) and 0.979 (leave-class-out). On plants, adaptation improves known-BGC recovery on n = 34 curated loci under strict 100% coverage, increasing recovery from 29.4% to 67.6% and indicating more complete boundaries. GO/KEGG-derived weak supervision reduces proxy primary-like ratio by 48.40% (GO) and 45.20% (KEGG), with consistent per-species reductions (paired Wilcoxon p = 1.53e-5). Compared to plantiSMASH, PlantBGC yields more compact loci on matched regions (median length ratio = 0.278; 93.8% of pairs are shorter).

AI.title_translation: PlantBGC：基于无标签领域自适应与弱监督的植物生物合成基因簇挖掘Transformer模型
AI.tldr: PlantBGC结合Transformer、无标签领域自适应和弱监督技术，将微生物BGC标注知识迁移至植物基因组，显著提升了植物BGC的挖掘精度和边界识别能力。
AI.motivation: 植物生物合成基因簇（BGC）编码特化代谢途径，但经过人工策展的植物BGC标签极为稀缺，限制了大规模监督学习挖掘。现有的基于规则或签名驱动的植物BGC挖掘工具缺乏捕捉长距离上下文表示的能力，在跨领域迁移时容易产生高假阳性。因此需要一种借助AI将微生物BGC的丰富标注知识迁移至植物基因组的有效工作流。
AI.method: 提出了PlantBGC模型：将基因组抽象为有序的Pfam结构域序列，使用仅编码器（Encoder-only）Transformer在MIBiG微生物BGC数据集上训练学习BGC相似性；进一步利用无标签掩码语言模型（MLM）进行植物基因组的领域自适应；同时结合GO/KEGG导出的弱监督信号抑制初级代谢等假阳性。
AI.result:
1. 微生物基准：Token级AUC在10折交叉验证中达0.988，Leave-class-out测试中达0.979。
2. 植物BGC恢复：在34个已策展位点上，自适应后已知BGC的完全覆盖恢复率从29.4%提升至67.6%。
3. 假阳性控制：GO和KEGG衍生的弱监督分别将初级代谢样比例降低了48.40%和45.20%（配对Wilcoxon p = 1.53e-5）。
4. 边界精准度：相比plantiSMASH，PlantBGC识别的基因座更紧凑（匹配区域中位数长度比为0.278，93.8%的匹配对更短）。
AI.conclusion: PlantBGC成功通过跨域迁移学习、无标签领域自适应和弱监督机制克服了植物BGC数据匮乏的难题，能够高精度、高效率地在植物基因组中识别BGC并精准界定其边界。
AI.translation: 植物生物合成基因簇（BGC）编码特化代谢途径，但人工策展的植物BGC标签仍然极其稀缺，阻碍了基因组规模的监督挖掘。现有的植物BGC挖掘工具主要依赖特征和规则驱动，未能充分利用上下文表示学习的最新进展来建立长距离领域上下文模型并控制强领域偏移下的假阳性。我们寻求一种AI辅助工作流，通过将监督信息从精心注释的微生物BGC迁移到植物基因组来缩小实验搜索空间。我们提出了PlantBGC，将基因组表示为有序的Pfam结构域序列，并使用在MIBiG微生物BGC上训练并通过无标签掩码语言模型自适应到植物的仅编码器Transformer来学习BGC相似性。在微生物基准上，PlantBGC实现了token级AUC = 0.988（10折交叉验证）和0.979（留类交叉验证）。在植物上，自适应在100%严格覆盖下将34个策展位点上的已知BGC恢复率从29.4%提高到67.6%，表明边界更完整。来源于GO/KEGG的弱监督使代理初级代谢样比例分别降低了48.40%（GO）和45.20%（KEGG），且各物种的降低具有一致性（配对Wilcoxon p = 1.53e-5）。与plantiSMASH相比，PlantBGC在匹配区域产生更紧凑的基因座（中位数长度比 = 0.278；93.8%的对更短）。
AI.summary: PlantBGC是一个利用Transformer进行植物生物合成基因簇（BGC）挖掘的新框架。该模型通过在微生物BGC上预训练、在植物基因组上进行无标签掩码语言模型自适应，并引入GO/KEGG弱监督，成功打破了植物标注数据不足的瓶颈，实现了更高精度和更精细边界的植物BGC发现。
AI.keywords: Plant BGC, Transformer, Domain Adaptation, Weak Supervision, Pfam-domain
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将无标领域自适应（掩码语言模型）与弱监督结合，巧妙地解决了植物BGC真实标注极度稀缺的难题。通过将微生物训练的Transformer模型迁移至植物，并利用GO/KEGG信息抑制假阳性，PlantBGC不仅提高了识别召回率，还显著精细化了基因簇边界，比传统基于规则的工具（如plantiSMASH）提供了更紧凑精准的搜索区域，具有强实用性。

title: LLM-Guided Initialization for Accelerated Hybrid Quantum-Classical Medical Image Classification
summary: Variational quantum algorithms often encounter barren plateaus, where cost gradients decay rapidly with increasing circuit depth, undermining the trainability of parameterized quantum circuits. This paper evaluates AdaInit (Adaptive Initialization), proposed by Zhuang and Cunningham, which uses large language models to propose initial parameters for quantum neural networks. We study a simplified single-query AdaInit variant paired with GPU-accelerated simulation in NVIDIA CUDA-Q and apply it to binary classification on the DMR-IR mammography dataset. AdaInit delivers 14.6 times higher gradient variance at initialization than random initialization (0.0095 vs. 0.0006), producing 160 times faster convergence (1.1s vs. 176 s) while maintaining the same classification accuracy of 61.4 percent. We provide theoretical analysis grounded in the geometry of parameterized circuit landscapes and show empirically that LLM-guided initialization places the optimizer in trainable regions of parameter space. Beyond performance, our results indicate that a single LLM query can yield informative parameters without iterative refinement, suggesting a low-overhead path to improved trainability. The findings validate AdaInit in a medical imaging setting and demonstrate its compatibility with GPU-accelerated quantum backends for practical speedups.

AI.title_translation: 面向加速混合量子-经典医学图像分类的LLM引导初始化
AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）为量子神经网络提供初始参数（AdaInit），有效破解了量子计算中的“贫瘠高原”难题，在医学图像分类任务中实现了160倍的训练收敛加速。
AI.motivation: 变分量子算法普遍存在“贫瘠高原”现象，即代价函数的梯度随量子电路深度增加而呈指数级衰减，导致参数化量子电路极难训练。为了解决这一可训练性瓶颈，需要更有效的电路参数初始化策略。
AI.method: 评估了AdaInit（自适应初始化）方法的简化单次查询变体，利用大语言模型生成量子神经网络的初始参数；结合NVIDIA CUDA-Q的GPU加速仿真技术，将其应用于DMR-IR乳腺钼靶数据集的二分类任务，并基于参数化电路几何学进行了理论分析。
AI.result: 在DMR-IR医学图像分类任务中，AdaInit在初始化时提供的梯度方差是随机初始化的14.6倍（0.0095对0.0006），在保持相同分类准确率（61.4%）的前提下，实现了160倍的收敛速度提升（1.1秒对176秒）。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析与实验验证表明，LLM引导的初始化能有效地将优化器置于可训练的参数空间区域。单次LLM查询即可提供高质量初始参数，无需复杂迭代，为提高变分量子算法的可训练性和实用加速提供了一条高效、低开销的新路径。
AI.translation: 变分量子算法经常遭遇贫瘠高原（barren plateaus）现象，即代价梯度随着电路深度的增加而迅速衰减，从而削弱了参数化量子电路的可训练性。本文评估了由Zhuang和Cunningham提出的AdaInit（自适应初始化）方法，该方法利用大语言模型来推荐量子神经网络的初始参数。我们研究了一种简化的单次查询AdaInit变体，结合NVIDIA CUDA-Q中的GPU加速仿真，并将其应用于DMR-IR乳腺钼靶数据集上的二分类任务。AdaInit在初始化时提供的梯度方差比随机初始化高14.6倍（0.0095对0.0006），在保持61.4%相同分类准确率的同时，实现了160倍更快的收敛速度（1.1秒对176秒）。我们提供了基于参数化电路景观几何学的理论分析，并在经验上证明了LLM引导的初始化能将优化器置于参数空间的可训练区域。除了性能提升外，我们的结果还表明，单次LLM查询即可产生有价值的参数而无需迭代微调，这提示了一条实现更高可训练性的低开销途径。这些发现验证了AdaInit在医学成像场景中的有效性，并展示了其与GPU加速量子后端的兼容性，从而带来了实际的加速。
AI.summary: 针对变分量子算法中的“贫瘠高原”问题，本文评估了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）指导量子神经网络参数初始化的方法（AdaInit）。通过单次LLM查询配合NVIDIA CUDA-Q GPU加速仿真，在DMR-IR医学图像分类任务中实现了14.6倍的初始梯度方差提升和160倍的训练收敛加速，同时维持了同等的分类准确率，为提升量子算法可训练性提供了低开销方案。
AI.keywords: 变分量子算法, 大语言模型, 贫瘠高原, 参数初始化, 医学图像分类
AI.comments:
创新点与重要性：将大语言模型（LLM）应用于量子神经网络的参数初始化是一种跨学科创新，成功缓解了阻碍变分量子算法发展的“贫瘠高原”难题。结合GPU加速（CUDA-Q）和单次查询设计，实现了极高的收敛加速（160倍）和低开销优势。
局限性：实验仅限于DMR-IR数据集上的二分类任务，且分类准确率相对有限（61.4%），该方法在复杂任务、更深量子电路及真实量子硬件上的有效性仍需进一步验证。

title: Stronger Lower Bounds for Tree Covers via Cyclic Symmetry
summary:
A tree cover of an $n$-point metric space is a collection of $k$ dominating trees such that every pairwise distance is approximately preserved by at least one tree. The best known general upper bound on the distortion is $\widetilde{O}(n^{1/k})$. Recently, Chen, Tan, and Xu (ITCS 2026, SICOMP 2026) proved a lower bound of $Ω_k(n^{1/2^{k-1}})$ using a topological approach.
  We improve their lower bound to $Ω_k(n^{1/[k(p-1)]})=Ω_k(n^{1/O(k^2)})$, where $p$ is the smallest prime strictly larger than $k$. Thus, the gap between the known upper and lower exponents is reduced from exponential in $k$ to a factor of $O(k)$.
  Our key observation is a qualitative difference between the antipodal symmetry underlying the binary labels in the previous approach and the cyclic symmetry used here. In the binary setting, every joint label has a unique antipodal partner, whereas every label in $\mathbb{Z}_p^k$ has many partners that differ from it in every coordinate. This flexibility allows an equivariant Borsuk--Ulam-type theorem in only $k(p-1)$ dimensions to produce two nearby vertices with different labels in all $k$ trees. A cyclic unwinding argument then shows that they are far apart in every tree.

AI.title_translation: 通过循环对称性获得更强的树覆盖下界
AI.tldr: 本文利用循环对称性和等变Borsuk-Ulam定理，将树覆盖失真度下界提升至 $Ω_k(n^{1/O(k^2)})$，将上下界指数差距缩小至 $O(k)$ 因子。
AI.motivation: 树覆盖失真度的已知最佳上界为 $\widetilde{O}(n^{1/k})$，而先前基于拓扑方法（二元对顶对称性）得到的下界仅为 $Ω_k(n^{1/2^{k-1}})$，上下界指数之间存在指数级差距，需要更强的拓扑工具来提升下界。
AI.method: 提出使用 $\mathbb{Z}_p^k$ 上的循环对称性（其中 $p$ 是大于 $k$ 的最小素数）替代传统的二元对顶对称性。利用 $k(p-1)$ 维的等变 Borsuk-Ulam 型定理寻找两个在所有 $k$ 棵树中标签均不相同的相邻顶点，再通过循环展开（cyclic unwinding）论证明其在所有树中均相距甚远。
AI.result: 将树覆盖失真度的下界提升至 $Ω_k(n^{1/[k(p-1)]})=Ω_k(n^{1/O(k^2)})$，使已知上下界指数之间的差距从关于 $k$ 的指数级缩小到仅差 $O(k)$ 因子。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入循环对称性和等变 Borsuk-Ulam 型定理，本文成功证明了更紧的树覆盖失真度下界，大幅缩小了该问题长期存在的上下界理论差距。
AI.translation:
$n$ 个点的度量空间的树覆盖是 $k$ 个主导树的集合，使得每对点之间的距离都能被至少一棵树近似保持。目前已知最通用的失真度上界为 $\widetilde{O}(n^{1/k})$。最近，Chen、Tan 和 Xu（ITCS 2026, SICOMP 2026）利用拓扑方法证明了 $Ω_k(n^{1/2^{k-1}})$ 的下界。
我们将他们的下界提升至 $Ω_k(n^{1/[k(p-1)]})=Ω_k(n^{1/O(k^2)})$，其中 $p$ 是严格大于 $k$ 的最小素数。因此，已知上下界指数之间的差距从关于 $k$ 的指数级缩小到了 $O(k)$ 因子。
我们的核心观察是，先前方法中二元标签所蕴含的对顶对称性与本文使用的循环对称性之间存在本质上的性质差异。在二元设定中，每个联合标签只有唯一的对顶伙伴；而在 $\mathbb{Z}_p^k$ 中，每个标签都有许多在每个坐标上都与其不同的伙伴。这种灵活性使得只需在 $k(p-1)$ 维空间中使用等变 Borsuk-Ulam 型定理，即可产生两个在所有 $k$ 棵树中标签均不相同的相近顶点。随后的循环展开论证表明，它们在每一棵树中都相距甚远。
AI.summary: 本文研究了度量空间中树覆盖的失真度下界问题。作者利用 $\mathbb{Z}_p^k$ 上的循环对称性替代先前工作中的二元对顶对称性，并结合等变 Borsuk-Ulam 型定理与循环展开论证，将树覆盖失真度的下界从 $Ω_k(n^{1/2^{k-1}})$ 提升至 $Ω_k(n^{1/O(k^2)})$，极大地缩小了树覆盖失真度上下界之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 树覆盖, 失真度下界, 循环对称性, Borsuk-Ulam定理, 拓扑方法
AI.comments: 本文在理论计算机科学和拓扑组合学交叉领域取得了重要突破。其核心创新在于敏锐地识别并利用了循环对称性（$\mathbb{Z}_p^k$）相比于传统二元对顶对称性的优势，显著降低了应用 Borsuk-Ulam 定理所需的空间维度。这不仅成功将树覆盖问题的下界指数差距从指数级大幅缩小至多项式级别 $O(k)$，也为拓扑方法在度量空间嵌入下界中的应用开辟了新思路。

title: Expected Survival-Time Bounds for Robust Optimization Over Time under Isotropic Gaussian Dynamics
summary: Robust Optimization Over Time (ROOT) is a recent branch of evolutionary dynamic optimization that seeks solutions capable of remaining effective across multiple consecutive environments. Unlike the traditional track-the-moving-optimum (TMO) paradigm, which reoptimizes after every environmental change, ROOT explicitly values persistence. Although the field has grown considerably, most contributions remain algorithmic and empirical, leaving several fundamental properties poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. One such property is survival time, defined as the number of future environments in which a deployed solution continues to satisfy a prescribed quality threshold. While survival time is widely used as a measure of temporal robustness, little is known about how its expected value depends on environmental dynamics, deployment quality, or problem characteristics. This paper studies expected survival time for a fixed deployed solution under isotropic Gaussian environmental dynamics. Modeling survival as a discrete first-exit problem, we derive a rigorous lower bound and a computable multi-step upper bound. The analysis shows that expected survival scales as $Θ(σ^-{2})$ in slowly varying environments and approaches its minimum value of one future change in high dimensions. A comprehensive Monte Carlo study validates the theoretical predictions, examines sensitivity to modeling assumptions and parameter uncertainty, and illustrates how the bounds can support deployment decisions after optimization. The resulting framework provides an analytical characterization of deployment lifetime and identifies when a required deployment horizon can be guaranteed, ruled out, or remains analytically unresolved.

AI.title_translation: 各向同性高斯动态下时间稳健优化的期望生存时间界限
AI.tldr: 本研究通过将生存期建模为离散首次退出问题，首次针对各向同性高斯动态下的时间稳健优化推导出期望生存时间的理论上下界，揭示了环境变化率和维度对部署寿命的影响。
AI.motivation: 时间稳健优化（ROOT）关注解在未来多个环境中保持有效的能力，但现有研究多偏向算法与经验层面。对于生存时间（部署解维持质量阈值的未来环境数量）这一关键指标，其期望值受环境动态、部署质量及问题特征影响的理论机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 将生存期建模为离散首次退出问题（discrete first-exit problem），推导出严谨的下界和可计算的多步上界，并通过全面的蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）实验验证理论预测及敏感性。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在缓慢变化的环境中，期望生存时间按 $\Theta(\sigma^{-2})$ 比例缩放；而在高维空间中，期望生存时间将趋近于其最小值（即仅能维持1次未来环境变化）。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该理论的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个用于分析部署寿命的理论框架，能够明确判断所需的部署时间跨度是否可以得到保证、被排除或仍处于未解决状态，为优化后的决策部署提供了理论支撑。
AI.translation: 时间稳健优化（ROOT）是演化动态优化领域的一个新分支，旨在寻找能够在多个连续环境中保持有效的解。与在每次环境变化后重新优化的传统“追踪移动最优解（TMO）”范式不同，ROOT 明确重视解的持久性。尽管该领域取得了长足发展，但绝大多数贡献仍集中于算法和经验层面，导致从理论视角来看，若干基本性质仍未得到充分理解。生存时间就是这样一种性质，它被定义为部署解能够继续满足规定质量阈值的未来环境数量。虽然生存时间被广泛用作测量时间稳健性的指标，但关于其期望值如何取决于环境动态、部署质量或问题特征，人们知之甚少。本文研究了在各向同性高斯环境动态下，固定部署解的期望生存时间。我们将生存期建模为离散首次退出问题，推导出严谨的下界和可计算的多步上界。分析表明，在缓慢变化的环境中，期望生存时间的缩放关系为 $\Theta(\sigma^{-2})$，而在高维环境中则趋近于其最小值（即1次未来变化）。全面的蒙特卡洛研究验证了理论预测，分析了对建模假设和参数不确定性的敏感性，并展示了这些界限如何支持优化后的部署决策。所得框架对部署寿命进行了分析表征，并能明确何时可以保证、排除或仍无法从分析上解决所需的部署时间跨度。
AI.summary: 本文针对各向同性高斯环境动态下的时间稳健优化（ROOT）问题，对固定部署解的期望生存时间进行了理论研究。通过将其建模为离散首次退出问题，推导出了期望生存时间的严谨下界与多步上界，揭示了其在慢变及高维环境下的渐近特性，并借助蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论界限对实际部署决策的指导价值。
AI.keywords: 时间稳健优化, 生存时间, 各向同性高斯动态, 首次退出问题, 期望生存界限
AI.comments: 该论文从理论角度填补了时间稳健优化（ROOT）领域中生存时间分析的空白。其创新点在于将部署解的生存期建模为离散首次退出问题，给出了严谨的下界与可计算的多步上界，并揭示了生存时间与环境变化率及空间维度之间的渐近关系。局限性在于分析假设了各向同性高斯动态，未来仍需探索非各向同性或非高斯等更复杂动态下的理论推广。

title: Toward Multi-Modal Deep Learning for Pulmonary Disease Classification: A Texture-Based Machine Learning Pilot Study on Public Chest X-Ray Data
summary: Automated classification of pulmonary disease from chest radiographs is a widely studied application of machine learning in medical imaging. This paper presents a pilot study evaluating classical texture- and gradient-based feature representations for distinguishing COVID-19 from other forms of pneumonia using the publicly available COVID-19 Image Data Collection (668 posteroanterior/anteroposterior radiographs from 408 patients). Using histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) and gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) texture descriptors with classical classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machine), evaluated under patient-level 5-fold stratified cross-validation to prevent data leakage, we obtain a best mean accuracy of 75.4% and AUC of 0.755, modestly exceeding the 71.6% majority-class baseline. We report these results transparently, including their limitations, and use them to motivate and scope a proposed multi-modal deep learning architecture -- combining convolutional and transformer-based encoders across imaging modalities -- as a direction for future work requiring access to larger, multi-institutional, ethically sourced datasets.

AI.title_translation: 迈向肺部疾病分类的多模态深度学习：基于公开胸部X射线数据的纹理机器学习试点研究
AI.tldr: 本试点研究评估了基于经典纹理特征的机器学习模型在胸部X射线图像中分类COVID-19与其它肺炎的局限性，并提出了未来多模态深度学习架构的发展方向。

AI.method: 基于公开的COVID-19图像数据集（来自408名患者的668张X射线胸片），提取方向梯度直方图（HOG）和灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）纹理特征，结合逻辑回归、随机森林及支持向量机分类器，并采用患者层面的5折分层交叉验证以防止数据泄漏。
AI.result: 模型获得了75.4%的最佳平均准确率和0.755的AUC，适度超过了71.6%的大多数类基线（majority-class baseline）。
AI.conclusion: 传统纹理与梯度特征配合经典分类器在区分COVID-19与其它肺炎时的表现仅略优于基线水平。以此局限性为依据，研究提出了结合卷积和Transformer编码器的多模态深度学习架构作为未来的关键突破方向。
AI.translation: 从胸部放射照片中自动分类肺部疾病是医学成像领域机器学习中被广泛研究的应用。本文展示了一项试点研究，利用公开可用的COVID-19图像数据集（来自408名患者的668张后前位/前后位胸片），评估了用于区分COVID-19与其他形式肺炎的经典纹理和梯度特征表示。通过使用方向梯度直方图（HOG）和灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）纹理描述符结合传统分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林和支持向量机），并在患者层面的5折分层交叉验证下进行评估以防止数据泄漏，我们获得了75.4%的最佳平均准确率和0.755的AUC，适度超过了71.6%的大多数类基线。我们透明地报告了这些结果及其局限性，并以此为动机和范围，提出了一个结合跨成像模态卷积与Transformer编码器的多模态深度学习架构，作为未来需要更大规模、多机构、符合伦理来源数据集的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文针对公开胸部X射线图像数据集开展了一项试点研究，评估了HOG和GLCM纹理特征配合传统分类器区分COVID-19与其它肺炎的表现。在严格防泄漏的交叉验证下，模型取得了75.4%的准确率。基于该结果，作者提出了未来基于CNN和Transformer的多模态深度学习架构。
